title: A $B_{1g}$ phonon unlocks $d$-wave superconductivity in the repulsive Hubbard model
abstract: Using numerically exact finite-temperature quantum Monte Carlo, we demonstrate that a $B_{1g}$ phonon coupled to the doped $t$-$t'$ repulsive Hubbard model produces genuine $d$-wave superconductivity at a substantial transition temperature, in excess of either interaction alone. The observed trends suggest that stronger Hubbard repulsion may cooperate with the phonon to further raise the pairing scale. The enhancement persists at stronger repulsion within the accessible window, limited by the fermion sign problem, and follows a common trend across phonon frequencies $\Omega$ when organized by a retardation scale $2\pi T/\Omega$. We also find a well-defined superconducting dome in doping, echoing a characteristic feature of correlated superconductors. Our results identify the $B_{1g}$ phonon as a plausible microscopic ingredient for robust $d$-wave superconductivity in the Hubbard model and suggest a concrete, physically motivated route toward materials with higher superconducting transition temperatures.
summary:
1. 作者用有限温行列式量子蒙特卡洛研究掺杂Hubbard模型，检验调制跃迁的B₁g声子能否与在位排斥协同产生d波超导。
2. 在20%空穴掺杂、U/t=1、Ω/t=4时，配对响应、超流密度及尺寸标度支持T_c/t≈0.04的d波转变，且低温有效配对吸引超过两者贡献之和。
3. 该协同机制提示提高配对尺度的可能，但受符号问题限制，铜氧化物相关的强排斥、低频声子区是否超导仍待检验。

title: Meta-Altermagnetism and Enhanced Spin-Splitting
abstract: Altermagnets are collinear magnets with zero net magnetization and spin-split electronic bands. Here, we explore whether altermagnetism can exhibit a discontinuous jump, a phenomenon we refer to as meta-altermagnetism. We show that meta-altermagnetism can emerge in 2D systems when magnetic-order-induced band reconstruction drives spin-split van Hove singularities (vHSs) across the Fermi level. Using mean-field theory for an extended $t$-$J$ model on a two-sublattice square lattice including anisotropic hopping integral, we find that a first-order meta-altermagnetic transition produces an intermediate altermagnetic regime with reduced staggered magnetization but strongly enhanced magnetic octupole and time-reversal-odd spin-splitter conductivity. We further show that the first-order transition line terminates at a quantum critical endpoint, giving rise to a rich phase diagram as the chemical potential and anisotropic hopping strength are varied. Our results identify the spin split vHSs as a route to enhancing spin-splitter effect for spintronic applications.
summary:
1. 作者对含各向异性跃迁的二维双子晶格t–J模型作平均场计算及局域朗道分析，研究交替磁性的自旋劈裂能否不伴额外对称破缺而跃变。
2. 自旋劈裂的范霍夫奇点越过费米能级诱发一级跃迁，中间态交错磁矩减小而d波磁化及时间反演奇自旋电导增强，另有跃迁线终止于量子临界端点。
3. 热展宽使跃迁变为交叉后增强仍保留，提示应变调控自旋流的可能，但满足能带条件的材料尚待寻找，平均场及恒定弛豫时间近似仍需检验。

title: MoireKP: An Automated Workflow for Symmetry-Constrained Moiré Continuum Models
abstract: First-principles Hamiltonians contain the electronic information needed to study moiré materials, but their size makes subsequent calculations costly. We present MoireKP, an automated workflow for constructing compact continuum models from localized-orbital ab initio Hamiltonians. The workflow constructs a valley-resolved truncated atomic-plane-wave (TAPW) Hamiltonian, selects a low-energy basis, and projects the crystal-symmetry operations into this basis. These representations determine the symmetry-allowed Hamiltonian terms, whose coefficients are obtained by projecting the low-energy effective Hamiltonian onto the corresponding operator basis. The model dimension, localized reference states, and harmonic cutoff can be selected automatically or specified by the user. This Hamiltonian-based construction retains wave-function information within the selected low-energy subspace. We apply the workflow to AA-stacked twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$, AB-stacked twisted bilayer ZrS$_2$, and A--AB twisted trilayer MoTe$_2$, covering K, M, and $\Gamma$ valleys. All models reproduce TAPW band energies within 3.0 meV in the target windows along high-symmetry $k$ paths.
summary:
1. 为兼顾莫尔低能建模的紧凑性与波函数信息，作者开发MoireKP，从第一性原理哈密顿量经截断原子平面波（TAPW）降维、自动选基及对称约束投影生成连续模型。
2. MoTe₂双层、三层及ZrS₂双层中覆盖K、M、Γ谷的六个模型为18—152维，无需拟合能带，能量对齐后在高对称路径上相对TAPW的均方根误差为0.62—1.07 meV。
3. 该流程可为多谷拓扑与多体计算提供紧凑输入，但量子几何检验仅限模型空间，不等同于完整微观布洛赫态几何。

title: Field theory of competing phases in the interacting Kitaev chain
abstract: We study the interacting Kitaev chain with nearest-neighbor interactions and finite chemical potential using a combination of bosonization and density-matrix renormalization-group calculations. Focusing away from special exactly solvable lattice limits, we develop a continuum field-theoretic description of the generic finite-density interacting regime, where doping nonperturbatively modifies the competition between superconducting pairing and commensurate charge ordering. We show that the phase diagram consists of an intermediate incommensurate Luttinger liquid between the topological superconducting and commensurate charge-density-wave Mott phases, as well as a trivial band-insulating regime at large chemical potential. The commensurate--incommensurate and incommensurate--topological-superconducting phase boundaries are governed by Pokrovsky--Talapov and Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless criticality, respectively. We analyze the interacting topological superconducting regime and its boundary excitations. At the semiclassical level, and explicitly in the free-fermion boundary theory, the topological phase supports exponentially localized Majorana edge modes at interfaces between topological and trivial regions. We also construct a dual continuum fermionic representation in which this topological bulk sector is described instead by conventional symmetry breaking. This gives a continuum version of the SPT--SSB correspondence between different fermionic representations. Overall, our results provide an analytical description of one-dimensional interacting topological superconductors, from the competition between topology and commensurability and the resulting quantum criticality to the dual symmetry-breaking description of the topological phase.
summary:
1. 作者结合玻色化、重整化群与DMRG，建立有限化学势近邻相互作用Kitaev链的连续场论，分析拓扑超导与公度电荷序的竞争。
2. 孤子增殖产生电荷有序莫特相与拓扑超导间的非公度卢廷格液体，纠缠熵拟合中心荷c≈1.088与c=1相容，两侧分别属Pokrovsky–Talapov和BKT临界性。
3. 改变局域算符代数的对偶表述联系了拓扑与离散对称性破缺，但尚未证明精确格点映射，一般相互作用马约拉纳边模的空间算符仍待构造。

title: Long-Range Toric Code: Finite-Temperature Topological Order in Two Dimensions
abstract: We introduce two-dimensional toric code models with additional long-range loop interactions. Our models preserve the topologically ordered ground states of the ordinary toric code, while confining anyons at zero temperature. For sufficiently long-ranged interactions, we argue that this confinement persists at finite temperatures, strongly constraining anyon mobility and giving rise to finite-temperature topological order. This topological phase acts as a self-correcting quantum memory and exhibits long-range entanglement. For shorter-ranged interactions, signatures of topological order survive only up to an exponentially large length scale at finite temperature, yielding a partially self-correcting quantum memory.
summary:
1. 为检验二维拓扑序的热稳定性，作者在环面码中加入耦合随周长幂律衰减的方形环稳定子，以环计数、蒙特卡洛与解码研究任意子禁闭。
2. 模型保留原基态且能量广延，稀薄四极簇图像与模拟支持衰减指数1<α≤2时的有限温拓扑序，而2<α≤3时热屏蔽使存储仅部分自纠错。
3. 这为二维自纠错存储及热态长程纠缠提供非局域候选机制，但非零威尔逊环平台和热力学极限下的发散存储寿命仍待严格证明。

title: Spin Space Symmetry Without Spin Space Groups
abstract: Spin space groups provide a complete symmetry classification of magnetic structures in the non-relativistic limit and have become an increasingly useful language for organizing magnetic phases and their physical properties. Each spin space group with a given parent space group is specified, up to spin-only symmetries, by a real representation of that space group acting in spin space. We argue that working directly with this representation not only avoids the construction and identification of the group, but also organizes and simplifies the resulting symmetry constraints on allowed responses. Determining the presence or absence of magnetic compensation, piezomagnetism, spin and charge transport, the Edelstein effect, and momentum-space spin textures becomes an ordinary problem in the representation theory of space groups. The resulting conditions reduce to overlaps between the three exterior powers of the defining representation and multipole representations of the point group. Several physically distinct responses then reduce to the same condition on the defining representation. For example, a $p$-wave spin texture and the time-even Edelstein effect are allowed under the same condition, as are piezomagnetism and a $d$-wave spin texture in compensated order. The wave-vector content of the exterior powers gives a further hierarchy of selection rules: depending on the relevant power, a uniform response requires one, two, or three ordering wave vectors to sum to a reciprocal lattice vector. These rules can exclude many responses before point-group symmetry is considered. We illustrate the approach with examples drawn from a wide variety of materials hosting collinear, coplanar and non-coplanar magnetic order. Finally, we discuss extensions of these results to magnetic space groups, connections to Landau theories of collinear order, and the characterization of odd-parity magnets.
summary:
1. 为判断非相对论磁序允许哪些响应，作者直接检验母空间群实表示的前三阶外幂与点群多极表示的重叠，无需构造自旋空间群。
2. 均匀响应的平移选择律按外幂阶数要求一至三个磁序波矢合为倒格矢，而CoTa₃S₆同手性层叠的理想四面体三Q态允许反常霍尔效应，却禁戒自旋电导与动量自旋纹理。
3. 该框架可简化磁响应筛选，但现有判据仅涵盖均匀线性情形，对称性允许不保证实际非零，非线性推广仍待研究。

title: Geometry-controlled active transport in smectic textures
abstract: Self-propelled particles moving through structured anisotropic media such as smectic liquid crystals exhibit transport properties that differ qualitatively from those in isotropic environments. Here we introduce a minimal model of an active Brownian particle whose propulsion axis is coupled to the layer-normal field of a smectic liquid crystal. Using numerical simulations complemented by approximate analytical calculations, we investigate the dynamics of an active particle in three representative two-dimensional smectic microstructures: a uniform planar texture, an isolated toroidal focal conic domain, and a periodic array of toroidal focal conic domains. For the planar and isolated focal-conic geometries, we characterize the crossover from short-time superdiffusion to long-time normal diffusion. In periodic focal-conic arrays, however, transport is controlled by two distinct persistence mechanisms whose relative importance depends on the Péclet number ($\mathrm{Pe}$) and the coupling strength $\varepsilon$ between the particle orientation and the smectic layer-normal field. At small $\varepsilon$, long-time diffusion is governed by the intrinsic persistence time of the active Brownian dynamics. At large $\varepsilon$, repeated scattering by smectic defects generates an emergent persistence time that dominates the transport. These results demonstrate that the competition between the intrinsic persistence of active motion and the mean free time between encounters with smectic defects provides a simple physical mechanism for the emergence of nontrivial diffusive behavior in structured anisotropic media.
summary:
1. 作者结合朗之万模拟与近似解析，研究推进方向与近晶层法线耦合的主动布朗粒子在平直纹理、孤立环形焦锥畴及其周期阵列中的二维输运。
2. 周期阵列强耦合时，重复缺陷散射使取向持续时间与佩克莱数Pe成反比，长时扩散系数由Pe²转为Pe标度，而高Pe下散射减弱、平方标度趋于恢复。
3. 这提示可通过纹理几何调控扩散，但模型限于二维静态背景，真实近晶中强取向耦合与重复缺陷散射的实现仍需实验探索。

title: GæniceN: a minimal model to relax magnetization states self-consistently in general artificial spin ices
abstract: Artificial spin ices are geometric arrangement of nanomagnets that exhibit reconfigurable magnetization states and GHz dynamics. Their investigation in the GHz regime is challenging because of the existence of multiple modes and the impact of magnetization deviations at the edges of the nanomagnets. A minimal model to capture such dynamics require three macrospins per nanomagnet, an approach that was implemented for generic artificial spin ices in the tool Gaenice. Here, we use the Gaenice framework to realize a relaxation method to stabilize magnetization states self-consistently, called GaeniceN. We implement the dissipative component of the Landau-Lifshitz equation in an iterative approach to efficiently converge to the relaxed state. As an example, we find our approach to correctly predict the transition between phases in a pyramid ASI subject to a low-magnitude external field by computing the system's average energy. Because they are rooted on the same framework, GaeniceN produces the initial condition needed for Gaenice to compute dynamics such as ferromagnetic resonance or band structures. Combined, these tools will be able to aid in the design of artificial spin ices with applications in magnonics.
summary:
1. 为使人工自旋冰磁态与动力学计算自洽，作者开发GæniceN，在每磁体三宏自旋框架中迭代求解朗道–利夫希茨方程的耗散项。
2. 迭代法在方形阵列测试中较直接积分提速约6.7倍，并预测金字塔阵列零场I型与I/II混合态的能量交叉倾角为60.4°，而实验低场估计约50°。
3. 该方法可为磁振子能带计算提供自洽初态，但三宏自旋近似对长纳米磁体完整翻转的描述仍受限。

title: Planar energetics do not determine twin persistence in nanocrystalline aluminium
abstract: Planar energetics are the standard descriptors of twinnability in face-centred cubic metals and the usual validation targets for interatomic potentials. Here we show that they do not determine whether deformation twins persist in nanocrystalline aluminium. Two machine-learned potentials reproducing the same zero-load slip curves and closely spaced layered energy surfaces predict, from a common separated-fault precursor under identical loading, retained twin coverage of 64\% and 14\%. The divergence traces to forces within distorted partial cores acting along the trailing translation that would remove an outer fault. Planar energetics do set the margin: an outer fault more than halves the incremental barrier for middle-plane shear, yet twin completion and fault removal remain separated by only 10--21 mJ m\textsuperscript{-2}. Whether an assembled twin persists is decided instead by the orientation of local traction relative to the full-slip bisector and by the arrival order of partial-slip fronts from the grain-boundary network.
summary:
1. 为检验平面缺陷能量能否预测纳米晶铝孪晶留存，作者结合两种机器学习势的拉伸模拟、受限层状能面与第一性原理位错芯力计算。
2. 平面缺陷能量相近的两势在同一前驱态和加载下给出约64%与14%的局部平均孪晶覆盖率，分歧对应层错消除通道的芯力差异，留存还受局部牵引方向与部分位错前沿到达次序控制。
3. 势验证需兼顾受载多层错能量与畸变位错芯力，而所提留存判据在实验应变率下仍待检验。

title: Finite-step statistical mechanics of scale-invariant learning: spectral equations of state and curvature transport
abstract: Stationary learning admits an ideal-gas description under restrictive noise assumptions. In neural networks whose gradient noise departs from these assumptions, however, an entropy-scaling relation resembling a Maxwell relation remains approximately valid. We ask which thermodynamic-looking relations follow from scale symmetry rather than equilibrium, and how departures from the ideal-gas description can be quantified, for discrete stochastic gradient dynamics with memory. An exact rescaling of trajectories explains the entropy relation without assuming thermal equilibrium. Within a local harmonic approximation, self-adjusting weight norms yield a spectral equation of state whose virial coefficients are set by moments of the curvature spectrum, and coupled parameter groups can sustain stationary probability currents. Our central result beyond this approximation is an exact curvature-transport identity. Together with a finite-step loss balance, it decomposes corrections to the harmonic fluctuation relation into measurable curvature changes, finite-step remainders, gradient-memory correlations and finite-window drift terms. A related displacement-weighted curvature change provides a diagnostic of the arrow of time; its mean and second moment give a lower bound on the relative entropy between forward and reversed state pairs. We also calculate the activation-boundary contribution to curvature for rectified teacher-student networks with Gaussian inputs. Tests in sphere models, teacher-student networks and convolutional networks on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 support the transport description and identify limits of the harmonic and cubic-remainder approximations. These results separate symmetry-based relations from equilibrium assumptions and provide quantitative diagnostics of nonideal fluctuations in learning dynamics.
summary:
1. 为厘清尺度不变学习中的热力学式关系是否需要平衡，作者分析含记忆的离散随机梯度动力学，并用球面模型、师生及CIFAR卷积网络检验。
2. 轨迹重标度证明熵标度关系无需平衡，精确曲率输运恒等式分解更新曲率偏差，两数据集Softplus网络的负输运与曲率亏损在误差内相容。
3. 该框架提供非平衡涨落和时间反演诊断，但三次余项近似不普适，参数对相对熵下界不等同完整优化器的熵产生。

title: Thermal laser evaporation of superconducting Nb films
abstract: Thermal laser evaporation (TLE) is an emerging physical vapor deposition (PVD) technique that uses continuous-wave lasers to evaporate even the most refractory elements. The deposition and characterization of superconducting refractory elements are of interest to assess the quality of films deposited by TLE. Here, we report the deposition of niobium (Nb) on c-plane sapphire using a home-built TLE system equipped with a 1070 nm continuous-wave fiber laser. A deposition rate of 0.19 Å/s was achieved with 533 W of laser power focused to a diameter of approximately 500 $\mu$m on a Nb target. A film with a thickness of $22.47 \pm 0.05$ nm and a root-mean-square (RMS) roughness of $0.23 \pm 0.02$ nm exhibited a room-temperature resistivity of $21.60 \pm 0.05$ $\mu\Omega\mathrm{cm}$ and a residual-resistivity ratio (RRR) of 5.71. The superconducting transition temperature, $T_\mathrm{c}$, of the film was measured as 9.24 K, only 10 mK below the bulk value, with a transition width of 29 mK. Among films deposited without substrate heating, the electrical and superconducting properties of the present films meet or exceed those deposited by other techniques. This work contributes to the emerging consensus regarding TLE as a versatile PVD method for refractory elements and compounds.
summary:
1. 为检验热激光蒸发能否在不加热衬底时制备高品质超导铌膜，作者用连续波激光扫描加热铌靶，在c面蓝宝石上制膜并开展结构与输运表征。
2. 含氧化层总厚约22.5 nm的最佳膜具有9.24 K的近体相临界温度和29 mK的转变宽度，残余电阻比5.71高于相近厚度、无衬底加热的常规沉积文献值。
3. 后续可考察衬底温度对织构与超导性的影响，而一片样品存放后临界温度下降提示长期稳定性仍需评估。

title: Level ordering in the linear $E \otimes e$ dynamic Jahn-Teller model
abstract: The ground level of the linear $E\otimes e$ dynamic Jahn-Teller model has long been believed to be the doublet with vibronic angular momentum $j = \pm\tfrac12$. We prove that, for arbitrary coupling strength, the $n$th level $E_{nj}$ in the subspace of fixed $j$ strictly increases with $|j|$ for every $n$, $E_{n,1/2} < E_{n,3/2} < E_{n,5/2} < \cdots$; in particular, the ground level is always the $j = \pm\tfrac12$ doublet. The proof uses only a unitary transformation that lowers $j$ by one, combined with the variational principle. We also give an explicit lower bound on the gap $E_{0,j+1} - E_{0j}$.
summary:
1. 针对线性E⊗e动态Jahn–Teller模型的基态对称性与能级排序，作者利用振电角动量平移的幺正变换和极小极大变分原理给出严格证明。
2. 任意耦合下，各角动量扇区的同序号能级随|j|严格升高，基态恒为j=±1/2双重态，并获得相邻|j|扇区最低能级差的正下界。
3. 排序定理亦适用于各向同性谐阱中的Rashba耦合单粒子体系，但不涵盖二次振电耦合，异频多模模型的排序仍待解决。

title: Crystoria: A Large-Scale Crystal Dataset Linking Thermodynamic and Dynamical Stability for Materials AI
abstract: Large-scale crystal databases have transformed materials discovery by making millions of structures and thermodynamic properties accessible to materials informatics. Yet dynamical stability remains sparsely characterized at a comparable scale because its evaluation is substantially more computationally demanding than conventional structure and energy calculations. This mismatch creates a critical gap between the rapidly expanding crystal-structure space and the physical information available for materials research and machine learning. Here we introduce Crystoria, a large-scale crystal dataset designed to bring dynamical stability to the scale of modern materials data. We construct Crystoria by systematically curating low-energy and metastable inorganic crystals, standardizing their structural identities, and combining machine-learning-accelerated structural relaxation with phonon-based dynamical screening. The resulting dataset contains 2,649,640 crystal structures, spanning 89 elements, 219 of the 230 space groups, and primitive cells containing 1-48 atoms. Among them, 1,793,353 structures (67.68%) are classified as dynamically stable, revealing substantial variation in dynamical stability across chemical and crystallographic space. By bringing dynamical stability to the scale of millions of crystal structures, Crystoria provides a physically grounded foundation for materials artificial intelligence (AI) and enables systematic exploration of the dynamical crystal landscape.
summary:
1. 为检验低能晶体的动力学稳定性，作者整合多源无机结构，结合机器学习势弛豫与有限位移声子计算构建Crystoria数据集。
2. 约265万结构中67.68%满足所设谐性稳定判据，而距参考凸包不超过10 meV/原子的结构仍有19.17%不稳定，表明低能筛选不能替代声子检验。
3. 该数据可支持兼顾相竞争与晶格稳定性的材料生成，但有限温稳定性仍需振动自由能及必要的非谐计算验证。

title: First-Principles Identification of Higher-Order Configurational Energy Terms and Their Magnetic-State Dependence in Lithium-Rich Oxyfluorides: From QUBO to HUBO
abstract: In this work, we use spin-polarized density functional theory (DFT) to identify substantial third-order, nonadditive configurational energy contributions in lithium-rich oxyfluorides that quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) models cannot represent. We test the extension from QUBO to higher-order unconstrained binary optimization (HUBO) in two disordered-rocksalt cathode materials, Li$_2$MnO$_2$F (LMOF) and Li$_2$Mn$_{0.5}$Ti$_{0.5}$O$_2$F (LMTiOF), using composition-preserving DFT energy maps. Using fixed-geometry energy maps, we show that cubic HUBO captures nonadditive contributions absent from QUBO models and substantially reduces fitting errors in both materials. Direct DFT energy differences confirm third-order nonadditivity, while comparisons of magnetic initializations reveal a strong dependence of the LMTiOF contribution on the converged electronic state. These results support the inclusion of higher-order terms when modeling configurational energetics and highlight the need to account for magnetic-state dependence in constructing DFT energy maps. The extracted terms describe effective couplings among composition-preserving exchange variables, rather than uniquely identified microscopic three-atom interactions.
summary:
1. 为检验构型能的二次近似，作者用自旋极化DFT+U构建Li₂MnO₂F与Li₂Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅O₂F在固定几何、固定成分下的能量图，对比QUBO与三次HUBO。
2. 三次项降低两体系的全图拟合误差，而含钛体系的直接局部三阶差分随磁初始化由−311变为−69 meV/24原子胞，显示二次模型遗漏的非加性依赖收敛电子态。
3. 所得项是位点交换变量间的有效耦合，不能直接认作微观三原子作用，推广至弛豫结构及电子基态能面仍待验证。

title: Time evolution in the multi-component dynamical Keldysh models
abstract: We construct a time evolution operator for a dynamical quantum models with a multi-component random Gaussian field characterized by a long correlation time. We analyze three paradigmatic cases: non-Abelian $SU(2)$ symmetry class for the three-component Gaussian noise and Abelian symmetry classes $U(1)$ and $Z_2$ for the two- and one-component noises correspondingly. Starting with a limiting case of the infinite correlation time (Keldysh model) we shown that statistics of the two-component random field with a non-zero mean is described by the Rice distribution. We derived and solved the system of coupled linear differential equations for the exact diagonal and off-diagonal single-particle Green's functions. We showed how the finite time correlation in Keldysh models are accounted by a continuous fractions method.
summary:
1. 针对长时相关高斯噪声下的两能级演化，作者在无限相关时间极限用Wei–Norman分解构造一至三分量Keldysh模型的演化算符并作无序平均。
2. 非零均值双分量模型中，场幅服从莱斯分布，对角与非对角格林函数均有精确积分表示，并满足耦合线性微分方程。
3. 连分式将计算推广至有限相关时间并描述赝隙底部的填充，而非零均值的非阿贝尔模型与双粒子格林函数仍待求解。

title: Structural Determination vs Stochastic Events: Relaxation Dynamics in a Supercooled Liquid
abstract: Structural relaxation in supercooled liquids is influenced by the initial configuration, yet its microscopic evolution exhibits substantial variability. Here, we investigate the interplay between structural constraints and dynamical stochasticity by examining fluctuations of relaxation dynamics across and within isoconfigurational ensembles. We show that fluctuations among trajectories originating from the same configuration constitute a substantial fraction of the total dynamical fluctuations over a broad range of temperatures. At the collective level, the distribution of relaxation times is well described by a stochastic model involving a sequence of effective relaxation events, whose number decreases upon cooling. At the microscopic level, dynamical fluctuations exhibit spatial correlations that grow upon cooling, revealing a spatial organization of relaxation even when the initial configuration is fixed. Remarkably, the characteristic length associated with these fluctuations closely follows the length scale inferred from the stochastic first-passage model, establishing a connection between the spatial organization of dynamical fluctuations and the temporal statistics of collective relaxation. Together, these results suggest that structural relaxation is governed by an interplay between configuration-dependent constraints and stochastic dynamical events: the initial structure influences when and where relaxation occurs, without uniquely determining its microscopic realization.
summary:
1. 作者用二维二元Lennard–Jones过冷液体的等构型分子动力学，结合重叠方差分解和首达时间统计，量化结构约束与轨迹随机性对弛豫的作用。
2. 低温弛豫时刻，等构型涨落占集体方差约一半、单粒子方差逾七成，其随降温增长的关联长度与首达模型在事件紧致假设下推得的尺度成比例。
3. 仅凭初始结构的单轨迹预测因此受限，但首达分布拟合并不唯一，独立事件与具体集体重排的对应仍待验证。

title: Layer-Parity Control of the Superconducting Diode Effect in Monolayer NbSe$_2$
abstract: The superconducting diode effect is often associated with finite-momentum pairing, although model studies indicate that rectification reflects the asymmetry of the free energy about its minimum rather than the equilibrium pair momentum itself. Using a Wannier-based, self-consistent finite-$\mathbf Q$ Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach with a Fermi-surface-adaptive quadrature that converges the critical currents, we show that the layer parity and orientation of magnetic proximity select the diode response of monolayer NbSe$_2$. For in-plane exchange, the equilibrium pair momentum $\mathbf Q_{\rm eq}$ and the diode efficiency are both linear in the layer-odd exchange contrast: parallel proximity on the two Se sublayers is reciprocal, and antiparallel proximity doubles the response. An out-of-plane component separates the two observables. It leaves $\mathbf Q_{\rm eq}$ nearly unchanged but, through pair breaking, suppresses the efficiency by more than an order of magnitude and, at low temperature, reverses it. Purely out-of-plane exchange, for which $C_3$ symmetry forbids a helical term, keeps $\mathbf Q_{\rm eq}=0$ yet produces a trigonal diode effect, controlled by the layer-even exchange and larger than the in-plane one above $0.65$~meV at low temperature. Magnetic layer parity thus selects between a helical and a trigonal diode channel. The trigonal channel is an intrinsic, symmetry-allowed contribution to the field-free rectification reported in NbSe$_2$/CrBr$_3$ and predicts that two-sided out-of-plane proximity cancels it when antiparallel and, at the same exchange per layer, enhances it about fourfold when parallel, in the computed range.
summary:
1. 作者结合Wannier模型、自洽有限动量BdG与费米面自适应积分，研究单层NbSe₂上下Se子层交换场如何控制配对动量与超导整流。
2. 面内层奇交换驱动螺旋通道，纯面外层偶交换产生零平衡动量的三重对称整流；倾斜交换下口袋间准粒子回流竞争可使螺旋通道效率受抑逾十倍并在低温反号，而平衡动量几乎不变。
3. 镜面等价界面下，两侧面外磁邻近反平行时应抵消整流，可在自旋阀中检验，但所算均匀态本征破对电流未必等于器件开关电流。

title: Far Tails of the Positional Distribution in random walk: A Saddle-Point Approach
abstract: Rare events and large-deviation theory have attracted considerable interest in the study of random walks. Here, we investigate the rare events of the positional distribution of continuous-time random walks under ordinary and equilibrium initial conditions using the saddle point method. We show that the far-tail behavior is sensitive to the expansion of the waiting-time distribution near its minimum value. For a general power-series expansion near the minimum waiting time, the positional distribution exhibits an approximately exponential decay in its far tails. In contrast, when the waiting-time distribution has a cutoff at its minimum value, the positional distribution exhibits an unexpected Gaussian decay, in contrast to the far-tail behavior of the renewal-count distribution. We further find that the most likely number of renewals required to reach a given position, as well as the associated rate functions, is insensitive to the initial conditions, whereas the far tails of the positional distribution retain a dependence on the initial conditions. Our results provide new insights into the rare-event statistics and large deviations of random walks.
summary:
1. 作者在高斯跳长的连续时间随机游走中，以更新次数分解和鞍点法研究等待密度近下界行为及普通、平衡初态对短时位移远尾的影响。
2. 近零广义幂级数产生含对数修正的近指数尾，正的等待下限使最大更新次数主导高斯尾，单侧莱维稳定指数为1/2时则给出4/3次压缩指数尾。
3. 幂级数情形下初态可改变远尾前因子而不改变主导更新次数和速率函数；平衡构造要求有限平均等待时间，有限老化效应仍待研究。

title: Ordered patches cap the stability of disordered frameworks
abstract: Structural disorder can stabilize frameworks against pressure-induced failure, yet the ordered regions it contains limit this gain. We show that, in rigid-jointed frames under hydrostatic pressure, an ensemble containing arbitrarily large patches of a crystal at positive density, whose centres carry a scaled crystal prestress, cannot stay linearly stable once those patches are stressed beyond the crystal's threshold for localizable instabilities. A homogeneous loss of positive definiteness while all Bloch modes, including the acoustic limit, remain stable cannot localize, leaving a window for stabilization. Extending an acoustic criterion to prestress, we show for all point groups that such a window requires a strain that keeps the crystal's symmetry. Unless the patches are shielded from stress, disorder cannot protect a crystal against a failure that breaks its symmetry, and protects a cubic crystal at most against volume collapse. In two-dimensional Truchet frames, planted ordered domains bring the threshold within 1% of the bound, and correlations short of long-range order localize failure on ordered clusters. Across 876 slender-strut nets, 798 fail first by a localizable instability; the other 78 have a median window of 7.6%. Stability gained through disorder is capped by the localizable instabilities of the local order it permits.
summary:
1. 作者将声学判据推广至预应力情形，分析静水压下刚接框架的无序增稳极限，并以二维Truchet框架及细杆网络检验。
2. 若任意大的晶体斑块以非零密度存在且中心承受按比例缩放的晶体预应力，晶体的可局域化失稳阈值限定线性稳定上限，植入有序区的二维模型阈值距上限不超过1%。
3. 有序区未受应力屏蔽时，无序不能防止破坏晶体对称性的失稳，对立方晶体仅可能延缓体积塌缩。

title: Swimming versus Screening: How Activity Reshapes the Ionic Cloud of a Charged Particle
abstract: A major question in active matter is how interactions between particles are modified by activity. Here, we address this question for Coulomb interactions by considering a charged swimmer immersed in an electrolyte. A static charge is screened by an ionic cloud that decays over the Debye length $\lambda_D$. We show that the persistent motion of the swimmer can qualitatively modify the steady-state ionic charge-density profile. At low activity, the swimmer appears effectively quasistatic to the ions, and conventional Debye-Hückel screening is recovered. At higher activity, the ballistic-to-diffusive dynamics of the swimmer are reflected in distinct spatial regimes. A power-law decay is followed by a stretched-exponential decay at intermediate distances. At sufficiently large distances, exponential screening is restored, but with an increased screening length, $\lambda>\lambda_D$, revealing activity-induced underscreening. Thus, active motion modifies both the spatial form and the range of electrostatic screening. Our results motivate the study of active electrolytes composed of positively and negatively charged swimmers.
summary:
1. 为研究持续自推进如何改变静电屏蔽，作者结合有色噪声模型与线性化离子输运—泊松方程，求解稀电解质中带电泳者的平均稳态离子云。
2. 高活性可使中程电荷密度呈1/R²幂律或拉伸指数衰减，远场恢复指数屏蔽但长度增至λ_D√(1+D_p/D)，其中λ_D为德拜长度，D_p与D分别为泳者和离子扩散率。
3. 典型参数估算表明水溶液仅能观测德拜屏蔽，慢载流子的非极性反胶束电解质可能提供检验上述理论预测的平台。

title: Topology of Wannierizable Insulators
abstract: We study the freedom in choosing Wannier centers and the associated symmetry representations in noninteracting Wannierizable insulators. We compare Wyckoff deformations of atomic configurations with symmetry-preserving adiabatic deformations of occupied states, both with and without adding common occupied atomic orbitals. Explicit examples show that stable Wyckoff equivalence and adiabatic equivalence at fixed filling do not imply each other. In spinless $Fm'm'm'$, an Euler class distinguishes stably Wyckoff-equivalent configurations. In spinless $P\overline1'$, adiabatically equivalent configurations remain distinct under stable Wyckoff deformations. We also classify when stable Wyckoff and stable adiabatic equivalence coincide. They agree in two or fewer dimensions and in three-dimensional spinful systems. For three-dimensional spinless systems, Chern insulator pumps give additional equivalences in 134 magnetic space groups. These groups preserve spacetime orientation and have a point whose site-symmetry group contains $222$, $\overline1'$, or $\overline4'$.
summary:
1. 作者用显式晶格模型与实空间谱序列，研究三维及以下非相互作用可Wannier化绝缘体的原子构型唯一性，比较Wyckoff与保隙绝热变形及加入共同占据轨道后的稳定等价。
2. 稳定Wyckoff等价与固定填充绝热等价互不蕴含，而两种稳定等价仅在三维无自旋体系的134个磁空间群中因陈绝缘体泵出现Z₂型差异。
3. 同一占据子空间可有不同稳定Wyckoff类的Wannier基，相应泵在固定表面终止且两端表面均处原子极限时必使表面能隙闭合。

title: Uniaxial strain tuning of functional properties in antiferroelectric PbZrO3 membrane capacitors
abstract: Lead zirconate (PbZrO3, PZO) is a prototypical antiferroelectric (AFE) system promising for applications such as energy storage and neuromorphic computing. However, in conventional thin-film architectures, its functional potential is often limited by substrate clamping. Although emerging freestanding membrane techniques offer an approach to release this clamping and enable dynamic strain engineering, a systematic understanding of how external strain modulates the switching between AFE and ferroelectric (FE) states is missing. In this study, we investigate the uniaxial strain effects on PZO membrane capacitors transferred onto flexible substrates via a gold-bonding method. We demonstrate that in-plane dynamic strain modulates the AFE-FE switching and functional properties. Corroborated by atomistic simulations, we reveal that the strain-dependent evolution arises from the superposition of the intrinsic strain dependence of specific domain orientation variants and extrinsic strain-induced redistribution of the relative population of different domain variants. These findings provide a predictive understanding of uniaxial strain tuning of AFE-FE switching in PZO, and pave the way for exploiting the functional potential of freestanding antiferroelectric membranes.
summary:
1. 作者以金键合将锆酸铅膜电容转移至柔性基底，结合弯曲电学测量、衍射与原子模拟，研究单轴应变对反铁电—铁电切换的调控。
2. 压缩收窄双电滞回线并提高储能效率，拉伸使其展宽，最大拉伸下极化回切比例由87%降至42%；机制为不同取向畴的本征响应与畴比例重分配叠加。
3. 这为按畴取向优化柔性储能器件提供依据，但强压缩下回线再次展宽尚属模拟预测，仍待实验检验。

title: The effects of hydrodynamic interactions on the swimming velocity and stability of a swarm of microswimmers
abstract: The dynamics and stability of a swarm of microswimmers is examined here using a thermodynamically compliant microswimmer model. The theory presented here is a mean-field model in which the swarm is considered to be a uniform solution of swimmers that are moving, on average, in the same direction. The hydrodynamic interaction between swimmers is modeled accurately assuming a crystalline arrangement to the swarm. A swimmer in the swarm can swim up to twelve times faster than when alone in an infinite sea, when the volume fraction of swimmers in the swarm is about 0.14. Moreover we have also studied the stability of the swarm around a uniform crystalline arrangement by calculating the hydrodynamic torques generated by the swarm as a function of the volume fraction of swimmers. The predictions presented here agree with recent multiparticle simulations that have shown that hydrodynamic torques have a stabilizing effect in swarms of pullers while swarms of pushers are generally destabilized by hydrodynamic interactions. The thermodynamically admissible coupling between the swimmer's motion and fuel consumption allows us to study the full dynamics instead of artificially constrained steady-states only. By accounting for fuel consumption and high order hydrodynamic interactions we are able to examine the swarm's stability as function of fuel concentration and the volume fraction of swimmers. We find that at high concentrations of fuel, swarms of pullers are stabilized by hydrodynamic torques for volume fractions of swimmers as low as 0.02 but at lower volume fractions Brownian forces make the swarm unstable.
summary:
1. 作者以耦合燃料消耗的热力学自洽哑铃平均场模型，结合周期晶格求和与布朗动力学，研究水动力对微泳者群速度及取向稳定性的影响。
2. 模型预测体积分数约0.14时泳速可达孤立泳者的12倍，水动力矩使推型失稳，而燃料充足期间拉型在体积分数低至0.02时仍可保持有序。
3. 这些预测可为拉型有序群泳实验选参提供参考，但仅检验预设晶格的稳定性，忽略近场及邻体浓度梯度，未解释有序态的自发形成。

title: Symmetries and Propagation of Surface Plasmon Polaritons in Axion Electrodynamics
abstract: Surface plasmon polaritons at the interface between a conductor governed by axion electrodynamics and an ordinary dielectric are studied using a general phenomenological model, in which the macroscopic response is described by an axial vector $ \mathbf{G} $, responsible for the anomalous Hall effect, and a pseudoscalar $ W $, accounting for the chiral magnetic effect. We extend the analysis of the chiral magnetic effect in the planar geometry, address its role in the cylindrical one and, in both geometries, discuss the case in which the two effects coexist. We find an upper bound on $ W $, a nonreciprocity requiring both effects and the absence of freely propagating modes, depending on the orientation of $ \mathbf{G} $, for the planar interface, and, for the cylindrical one, a novel coupling between the linear and orbital angular momenta of the modes, which already arises from the chiral magnetic effect alone and persists when the anomalous Hall effect is also present. The exact eigenmodes of the axion medium are derived, and the symmetries and propagation features of the surface modes are made explicit by analytical and asymptotic evaluation of the dispersion relations.
summary:
1. 为研究反常霍尔与手征磁效应如何改变表面等离激元传播，作者在无耗散轴子电动力学模型中求解平面及圆柱导体—电介质界面本征模，并作渐近与数值色散分析。
2. 平面法拉第构型仅在两效应共存时非互易，而圆柱中手征磁效应单独即可耦合轴向动量与轨道角动量，两效应共存还使零轨道角动量模非互易。
3. 这提示利用内禀响应构建非互易波导的可能，但分裂能否观测仍需计入损耗、非局域及界面效应后评估，并明确维持非平衡手征磁响应的机制。

title: Large connectivity expansion of Ising Spin Glasses on random graphs
abstract: We compute a high-connectivity analytical expansion for Ising spin glasses on sparse random graphs. We expand the cavity equations around the fully-connected mean-field limit, focusing on the critical behavior of the system: our approach allows us to compute the de Almeida-Thouless line of mean-field finitely-connected systems in the temperature $T$--magnetic field $H$ plane, by means of closed analytical equations. The exact cavity solution of such systems can only be obtained by solving numerically iterative equations, so our approach brings a notable computational advantage. On the theoretical side, we are able to identify three sources of corrections to the fully-connected mean-field solution: i) the non-Gaussianity of the cavity fields, ii) the statistical correlation between the cavity fields and their fluctuations, and iii) the corrections to the cavity filter functions. These corrections are treated using two different expansions: a non-uniform expansion, where we expand all three contributions around the mean-field solution, and a uniform expansion, where we only expand the statistics but leave the cavity filters untouched. The former allows for a direct comparison with the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model but fails at low temperatures, as a consequence of the de Almeida-Thouless line diverging in the zero-temperature limit. On the other hand, the uniform expansion describes with good accuracy the critical behavior of the system. We also extend these results to the $T = 0$ limit.
summary:
1. 为解析有限连通自旋玻璃的副本对称失稳边界，作者对随机正则图伊辛模型的腔场及扰动统计作大连通度Hermite展开，并保留完整滤波函数。
2. 所得闭合积分方程在连通度c≥10时较好再现全温区数值dAT线，且零温临界场在均匀场与半高斯场下分别按√ln(c−1)与√(c−1)渐近增长。
3. 该方法降低了临界线求解的计算负担，但向矢量自旋及近似消息传递算法的推广仍待验证。

title: A Luminescent Organic Triradical as an Optically Addressable Qudit
abstract: Luminescent molecular trityl radicals provide options for optically-addressable electron spins and are promising for quantum sensing. Here, we present a luminescent triradical comprising three trityl groups covalently attached to a central phenyl ring. We find two distinct photoluminescence bands at 633 nm and 690 nm with different temporal evolutions, which we attribute to excited quartet and doublet states respectively. The ground state quartet is 1 meV (11.5K) lower in energy than the doublet, resulting in near-equal population of doublets and quartets at room temperature. We demonstrate optically initialized spin polarization, coherent control of the ground state quartet, and optical readout. Potential for optical quantum sensing is shown via optically detected magnetic resonance at room temperature and magneto-photoluminescence up to 3% at 5 mT. This material is a candidate optically addressable molecular qudit, providing opportunities to leverage larger state spaces than qubit systems.
summary:
1. 为探索分子多能级自旋的光学寻址，作者研究了由中心苯环共价连接三个三苯甲基自由基的发光体系。
2. 实验实现自旋光学初始化、基态四重态相干控制与光学读出，并观测到室温光探测磁共振及5 mT下最高3%的光致发光变化。
3. 基态四重态仅比双重态低1 meV，室温两者近等布居；该分子为光学传感与多能级量子编码提供候选平台，编码应用仍待验证。

title: Transverse momentum transport and collective-mode localization in dipolar tube arrays
abstract: We study transverse transport of longitudinal momentum in an array of one-dimensional Bose gases coupled by dipolar interactions without particle tunneling. Within zero-temperature Bogoliubov theory, we characterize this transport using the inter-tube momentum correlator and its squared magnitude, termed amplitude and intensity. In a uniform array, pairs of Bogoliubov quasiparticles propagate ballistically across the tubes, while their dephasing produces a $t^{-3}$ decay of the long-wavelength amplitude. Tube-to-tube density imbalance acts as quenched disorder and localizes the transverse collective modes. At fixed longitudinal momentum, this arrests the growth of the intensity profile, whose time-averaged spatial decay measures the localization length. Equal-time correlations are much less sensitive to disorder and primarily reflect the interaction range: in the uniform array they decay with tube separation as $r^{-7}$ for dipolar coupling, compared with exponential decay for nearest-neighbor coupling. Finally, sufficiently strong inter-tube repulsion destabilizes the longitudinally uniform state toward density modulations staggered between neighboring tubes, at a threshold independent of density imbalance.
summary:
1. 作者用零温Bogoliubov理论研究无粒子隧穿的偶极耦合一维玻色管阵列，以管间动量关联及其模平方（强度）刻画纵向动量的横向输运。
2. 固定非零纵向动量下，均匀阵列的强度分布弹道展宽，管间密度无序使横向集体模局域化并令展宽饱和，典型长时平均强度的空间衰减率渐近为最长局域长度倒数的四倍。
3. 单管动量激发有望检验这一诊断，但须抑制残余隧穿，有限温度与碰撞下是否出现黏性耗散仍待研究。

title: Spectrum of the steady-state distribution function of disordered Lindbladian fermions at large channel number
abstract: Free fermions coupled to particle gain and loss relax to a Gaussian steady state, in which every natural orbital has its own occupation. We find the distribution of these occupations $\varrho_{\rm st}$ for a random Hamiltonian coupled to many random gain and loss channels. Each orbital is filled and emptied at its own rates, and the Hamiltonian, moving particles across the levels during their lifetime, averages the differences between the orbitals. We show that this averaging is incomplete: the spread of the occupations decreases only as the inverse square root of the number of channels per level. At large system size the distribution depends on the grain Hamiltonian only through its density of states $\nu(E)$. The spread is bounded by the baths alone: even Hamiltonians with unbounded, heavy-tailed spectra cannot widen it beyond this bound. The spread suppresses the particle-number fluctuations below their binomial value.
summary:
1. 作者研究随机增益与损耗下无序自由费米子的稳态占据差异，以大通道数展开求解李雅普诺夫方程，建立模哈密顿量谱的矢量戴森方程。
2. 谱宽随每能级通道数$m$按$m^{-1/2}$而非$m^{-1}$收缩，大体系中哈密顿量仅通过态密度影响谱形，重尾情形仍受浴设定的领先阶谱界约束。
3. 占据差异导致同平均填充下的亚二项粒子数涨落，提供非均匀稳态的宏观信号，但上述普适性要求耗散窗口包含许多能级。

title: Effect of the surface on the energy levels in PbS and PbSe nanocrystals
abstract: The structure of the electron and hole quantum confinement levels in spherical PbS and PbSe nanocrystals (NCs) is studied within the framework of a four-band effective-mass model. This level structure was initially calculated within the Kang--Wise model, which employs the standard boundary condition of vanishing carrier wave functions at the NC surface. This model, however, does not allow one to account for the effect of the NC surface on the level structure. Here, the effect of the NC surface is modeled using general boundary conditions (GBCs) imposed on the envelope wave functions at the surface. We show that the surface properties modify the size dependence of the electron and hole confinement levels and lead to an additional spin--orbit splitting of the $1P_{h,e}$ levels. Using the GBCs, we are able to quantitatively describe the size dependence of the lowest optical transitions in bare PbS and PbSe NCs and explain the differences between the absorption spectra of bare and Cl-passivated PbS NCs
summary:
1. 为研究表面对电子与空穴限域能级的影响，作者在球形PbS、PbSe纳米晶四带有效质量模型中，由零法向流条件推导允许表面包络函数非零的广义边界条件。
2. 计算得到1P态额外自旋轨道劈裂，裸纳米晶最低跃迁尺寸依赖的拟合均方根误差分别为1.6和2.5毫电子伏，加入表面张力项可描述氯钝化蓝移。
3. 模型提示钝化或可改变载流子g因子，但尚待实验检验，且提取的表面参数依赖尺寸标定。

title: Learning Between the Lines: Interaction Interpolation in a Multi Element Machine Learning Interatomic Potential
abstract: The continuous development of machine learning inter-atomic potentials (MLIAPs)has greatly accelerated materials research in recent years. However, the need to con- struct custom MLIAPs for each unique problem remains a bottleneck which raises the question of the transferability of MLIAPs. While foundation MLIAPs can achieve transferability due to the broad coverage of chemical space represented in their training sets, their size and computational cost limits their routine use. We address this gap by developing a lightweight general-purpose MLIAP for metal alloys spanning twelve elements (Al, Sc, Ti, V, Cu, Zn, Zr, Nb, Mo, Hf, Ta, W). Here, we utilize a step-wise active learning (AL) approach to develop a compact yet diverse dataset and model that generalizes well by interpolating from previously seen interactions. The resulting potentials transfer effectively to unseen, higher body-order alloys systems, requiring only unary and binary training data to capture ternary and quaternary systems. The model also transfers well to new elements via an alchemical extrapolation within the network, requiring only unary data for the new element and its alloys. These findings suggest that MLIAPs trained on targeted, diversity-driven datasets provide transferability at a relatively low computational cost, offering a practical path toward general-purpose, resource-efficient MLIAPs for materials modeling.
summary:
1. 为检验合金势对未见元素组合的迁移能力，作者通过分阶段主动学习与密度泛函标注，训练了覆盖12种金属的HIP-NN神经网络势。
2. 仅用单质与二元数据训练即可预测三元及四元合金能量，等原子比体心立方四元测试集的平均绝对误差为0.09 eV/原子。
3. 该策略有望减少通用势的数据需求，但仅靠纯金数据扩展的模型仍系统高估含金二元合金能量，向共价及反应体系的推广尚待检验。

title: Thermodynamic cost of locally maintaining a steady state
abstract: The Gibbs states of local Hamiltonians have short-range conditional correlations. To maintain a steady state with long-range conditional correlations, one might expect that a stochastic process must ``pay'' either in nonlocal moves or entropy production. Surprisingly, we find strictly local Gaussian processes that obey detailed balance and have unique steady states with arbitrarily long-range conditional correlations. We show that such processes must still produce entropy, if implemented using a local quadratic Hamiltonian coupled locally to equilibrium, rapidly relaxing baths. We lower-bound this entropy production in terms of the steady state's conditional mutual information (CMI); if the CMI decays exponentially with distance, the associated length-scale is called the Markov length $\xi$. The entropy production per site per relaxation time obeys $\hat\sigma \ge c \xi^2$ for large $\xi$, and with $c$ an implementation-dependent constant. We also bound the tradeoff between coupling range and entropy production. We contrast these Gaussian processes with jump processes on discrete state spaces, for which, under certain irreducibility assumptions, steady states with long-range CMI are only possible if detailed balance is violated. We conjecture (and present evidence) that rapidly mixing local jump processes cannot stabilize steady states with long-range CMI.
summary:
1. 为量化局域维持长程条件互信息的代价，作者构造满足细致平衡且稳态唯一的局域高斯链，并优化其线性热浴实现。
2. 其正则化稳态的马尔可夫长度ξ可任意大，但在局域二次哈密顿量和固定范围马尔可夫热浴的实现中，大ξ时每格点每弛豫时间的熵产满足σ̂≥c_rξ²，近邻双浴构造达到此界。
3. 该平方界依赖上述实现约束，相互作用体系的最小耗散及快速混合离散跃迁过程能否维持长程条件互信息仍是开放问题。

title: Development and application of a machine learning potential for diamond surfaces and their sliding interfaces with silicon nitride and silica: effect of passivation, orientation and load
abstract: Friction and wear of diamond are controlled by its surface chemistry, which determines whether covalent bonds form across the sliding interface. First-principles simulations have explored the role of surface orientation and passivation, but are limited to a few hundred atoms and tens of picoseconds. To bridge this gap, we develop a reactive machine learning interatomic potential for the C/H/N/O/Si chemical space, covering diamond, silicon nitride, silicon oxide, their surfaces, interfaces, and environmental molecules. The potential is trained on a large dataset of diverse structures and is tested on multiple physical properties, including ab initio reaction barriers on diamond surfaces, and structural/mechanical properties of amorphous Si$_3$N$_4$ and SiO$_2$. We then simulate sliding of diamond-Si$_3$N$_4$ interfaces with four surface orientations, clean and H/OH-passivated terminations, and normal loads from 0.1 to 23 GPa. We identify two different regimes: one where sliding is localized at the interface, and shear stress is proportional to the interfacial bond density, and another where shear is distributed inside the softer material, and adhesion due to full interfacial bonding dominates. These results show how passivation, surface orientation and load together determine interfacial bonding and friction, with implications for the environmental sensitivity of diamond wear. More broadly, the potential enables reactive simulations of diamond, silicon nitride and silica with near-ab initio accuracy at length and time scales beyond first-principles methods, providing a useful tool for future studies of wear at plowing asperities, chemical-mechanical polishing, and properties of amorphous ceramic films.
summary:
1. 作者以三万余个DFT构型训练C/H/N/O/Si反应性MACE势，通过纳秒级滑动模拟研究晶向、钝化与载荷如何调控金刚石—氮化硅界面摩擦。
2. 界面滑移时剪应力随成键密度线性增加，强键合使剪切转入氮化硅，形成由塑性流动限定的7–8 GPa剪应力平台。
3. 氢/羟基钝化在低载下抑制成键、近犁削压力时保护减弱，为环境敏感磨损提供机制依据，但尚未定量预测磨损率。

title: Separating the Density Wave Phase from Zero-Resistance Superconductivity in La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$
abstract: Identifying the key ingredients for superconductivity under pressure in the Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates remains a formidable challenge, due to a complex interplay between structural variations, oxygen content and location, electronically ordered phases, and the need for high pressures to reach the superconducting phase. To disentangle these complex inter-dependencies, here we study a series of clean single crystals of trilayer La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$. We discover that enhanced biaxial, compressive pressures induce a zero-resistance state at a 60\% lower pressure compared to previous reports. At the same time, we completely separate the low-pressure density wave phase from superconductivity, effectively ruling out that soft, quantum critical fluctuations of the density wave order parameter act as the pairing glue in this system. Our results establish biaxial, in-plane pressures as a powerful tool for promoting superconductivity in nickelates, unifying the required pressure scales for superconductivity in different Ruddlesden-Popper structures, and providing a connection to the recently discovered thin film samples.
summary:
1. 为厘清压力各向异性对密度波与超导的作用，作者结合高压输运与同步辐射衍射，比较三层La₄Ni₃O₁₀单晶的面内外压缩效应。
2. 增强面内双轴压缩后，密度波输运特征在8—10 GPa消失，而17.2 GPa即实现零电阻，所需压力较既有报道降低约60%。
3. 相区分离不支持密度波量子临界涨落主导配对，但输运结果仍不能排除短程密度波或非临界涨落的作用。

title: Nonreciprocity Propels Nematic Defects
abstract: Nonreciprocal interactions are a generic source of nonequilibrium dynamics, yet their consequences for nematic topological defects remain unexplored. We introduce a nonreciprocal nematic model on a two-dimensional hexagonal lattice and formulate a continuum theory containing a nematic nonreciprocal torque. In the deterministic limit, simulations and symmetry analysis show that this torque drives +1/2 defects to self-propel along their polar axes. Nonreciprocity modifies the splitting pathway of integer +1 defects. These results identify a symmetry-resolved route from nonreciprocity to nematic defect transport and topological reorganization, distinct from active-stress-driven motion.
summary:
1. 为探究非互易作用如何改变向列缺陷动力学，作者构建二维三角晶格模型与正则化Q张量理论，结合零噪声模拟和对称性分析。
2. 非互易力矩无需流场即可驱动+1/2缺陷沿极轴自推进，而保持三重对称的孤立−1/2缺陷无内禀平移，较强耦合还可使+1缺陷分裂为三个+1/2和一个−1/2缺陷。
3. 这为缺陷输运设计提供了不依赖活性应力的理论路径，但有限温度稳健性及晶格辅助四缺陷分裂的连续介质普适性仍待检验。

title: Response of Hydrogels and Microgels to Nanoparticle Crowding
abstract: Internal degrees of freedom of cross-linked polymer networks enable compressible hydrogels and microgels to swell or deswell by absorbing or expelling solvent in response to environmental changes. Macromolecules in solution can influence the swelling response by acting as crowding agents, with practical relevance for drug delivery and biosensing. We extend the Flory-Rehner theory of polymer network swelling to incorporate nanoparticle crowders as another implicit species that can perturb a gel through volume exclusion, including the entropic cost of crowder penetration from polymer field theory. Within the free energy landscape of asymmetric ternary mixtures, we numerically solve equilibrium relations equating solvent and crowder chemical potentials inside and outside the gel. Independently, we perform Monte Carlo simulations, including trial moves that allow gels to swell and take up crowders. We investigate how crowder size, solution concentration, cross-link density, and solvent quality influence swelling of polymeric gels, partitioning of crowders between inside and outside, and structural properties of microgel suspensions governed by Hertzian elastic pair interactions. Our results show that nanoparticle crowding promotes deswelling, thereby weakening interparticle correlations, and that, with increasing the concentration of crowders, polymeric gels reach a maximum loading capacity, dependent on crowder size and polymer cross-link density.
summary:
1. 为研究纳米粒子拥挤下凝胶溶胀与吸收的耦合，作者将排除体积和渗入熵代价纳入Flory–Rehner理论，结合化学平衡求解与蒙特卡洛模拟。
2. 混合熵主导退溶胀，装载量随储液浓度先增后减且峰值依赖粒径和交联密度，悬浮液模拟还显示收缩可在恒温、固定数密度下诱发晶体熔化。
3. 这些预测提示可借拥挤调控装载与释放，但当前平均场描述限于低浓度硬球拥挤剂与均匀交联网络，仍待分子尺度模拟及实验检验。

title: A rhombic spin-1 interpretation of a room-temperature GaN emitter
abstract: Single defects in GaN show optically detected magnetic resonance at room temperature. In the more abundant class, a minimal $S=3/2$ model leaves a $g\approx 4$ line unexplained. For one defect, this line lies near the sum of the two outer lines, consistent with transitions among three shared levels. A rhombic $S=1$ model reproduces the three line positions with rms errors of 8.1-9.8 MHz. The tested second-order $S=3/2$ fits containing all three transitions and the published minimal model do not reproduce these positions. A ladder fitted to the strong lines remains viable if the $g\approx 4$ line is a separate transition near the sum of the outer two. An unresolved frequency-window shift prevents the existing data from establishing the $S=1$ assignment uniquely. We propose a zero-field sweep that directly tests the isolated $S=1$ assignment.
summary:
1. 为厘清GaN室温单缺陷的自旋归属，作者重析公开光学探测磁共振数据，以频率组合关系和自旋哈密顿量拟合检验不同模型。
2. 缺陷2的弱线接近两外侧线频率之和，将中央线另计的菱形各向异性S=1模型以8.1–9.8 MHz均方根误差拟合三线位置，优于所检验的含这三条跃迁的二阶S=3/2模型。
3. 跨频窗偏移和组合残差随场漂移使归属仍不唯一，连续追踪外侧线至零场可检验孤立S=1预测的非零频率与偶对称二次场移。

title: The End of Chaos at the Ideal Glass Transition
abstract: The ideal glass transition has often been associated with the extrapolated vanishing of configurational entropy $S_c$, yet how this thermodynamic criterion is reflected in microscopic dynamics remains unclear. Here, we show that the vanishing of deterministic chaos quantified by the maximum Lyapunov exponent $\lambda_{\mathrm{max}}$ provides such a dynamical signature. Using molecular dynamics simulations across diverse model glass-forming liquids in two and three dimensions, we show that $\lambda_{\mathrm{max}}$ follows an approximate scaling $\lambda_{\mathrm{max}} \propto (T-T_{\lambda})^{1/2}$ and extrapolates to zero at a temperature $T_{\lambda}$ consistent with the Kauzmann temperature $T_{\mathrm{K}}$. Furthermore, we establish the quantitative relation $\lambda_{\mathrm{max}}^2 \propto T S_c$, directly linking chaotic dynamics to configurational entropy. By demonstrating that $\lambda_{\mathrm{max}}^2 \propto \sigma_K^2$, where $\sigma_K^2$ is the variance of local potential energy landscape curvature fluctuations, we connect the suppression of chaos directly to landscape geometry. These results provide a unified thermodynamic, dynamical, and geometric framework for glass formation, identifying the ideal glass transition as the endpoint of chaotic exploration of the energy landscape.
summary:
1. 为寻找理想玻璃转变的微观动力学标志，作者在二维、三维千粒子玻璃形成模型中，结合分子动力学与切空间积分计算最大李雅普诺夫指数。
2. 该指数平方近似随温度线性变化，并分别正比于温度与构型熵之积和势能景观曲率的时间方差，其外推零点接近考兹曼温度。
3. 这些关联为熵危机提供了候选动力学判据，但混沌终止尚依赖外推，不能据此确认有限维理想玻璃转变的存在。

title: Two faces of symmetry match in gear-like coupled rotary motors
abstract: Rotary molecular motors commonly couple components with different rotational symmetries, but how this gearing controls energy transduction remains unclear. Here we show that symmetry can produce a fundamental tradeoff in coupled stochastic barrierless rotary motors: the gear ratio that maximizes output power under tight coupling is also the ratio that requires the strongest coupling to remain locked. Consequently, weakening the coupling can invert the effect of gearing, transforming a power maximum into a local minimum. At strong driving, both the power-optimal and most slip-susceptible ratios approach symmetry match. Numerical solutions of the Fokker-Planck dynamics for rotors with finite energy barriers reproduce these predictions and reveal how the behavior changes when driving strength is fixed per rotation or per subunit. Motivated by the bacterial flagellar motor, these results identify coupling strength as a key determinant of whether matched rotational symmetries enhance or suppress energy transduction, providing a general design principle for coupled molecular motors.
summary:
1. 作者结合解析推导与福克–普朗克方程数值求解，研究每转或每亚基驱动自由能固定时，齿轮式耦合布朗转子的对称性如何影响输出功率。
2. 每转定驱动下，无势垒模型的紧耦合功率最优齿比也使确定性锁定所需耦合最强；有限势垒计算显示，强驱动时对称匹配处功率峰可随耦合减弱、滑移增多转为局部谷。
3. 所考察的每亚基定驱动情形未见此反转，提示马达设计需统筹齿比、驱动与耦合，而对真实细菌鞭毛马达的解释仍待验证。

title: The Constructive Cavity Method for the Ising Perceptron
abstract:
We apply the Constructive Cavity Method (CCM) to the Ising perceptron. The process starts from positive soft channels admitting an auxiliary representation $$ U(x)=\int_{\mathbb{R}} e^{tx}ho(\mathrm{d}t),\qquad ho\ge0, $$ with an auxiliary measure having a finite exponential quadratic moment. This rewrites the perceptron as a dense, bipartite Gaussian model with an Ising layer and a continuous auxiliary layer. The CCM blanket geometry then gives two constructive variance profiles, $Q_\ell$ on the Ising side and $\Gamma_\ell$ on the auxiliary side. The bipartite shell scale is $$ Q_{\ell+1}\Gamma_{\ell+1}-Q_\ell\Gamma_\ell, $$ and Gaussian core comparison removes the core contribution $\Delta Q_\ell\Delta\Gamma_\ell$ under blanket refinement. The scalar cavity functional has three terms, $$ \mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{perc}}(
u)=\mathbb{E}\left[\log\langle2\cosh xangle_
u+\alpha\log\langle U(s)angle_
u-\log\langle e^yangle_
uight], $$ where $x$ is the new-spin field, $s$ is the new-constraint field, and $y$ is the cavity correction. CCM identifies the constructive cavity variables with the Aizenman--Sims--Starr random overlap structure (ROSt) variables. Parisi's recursive averaging then gives $$ \mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{perc}}^{\mathrm{CCM}}(\zeta,Q,\Gamma)=X_0(0)+\alpha Y_0(0)- rac{1}{2}\sum_{\ell=0}^{R}\zeta_\ell\left(Q_{\ell+1}\Gamma_{\ell+1}-Q_\ell\Gamma_\ellight). $$ The replica-symmetric specialization gives Gardner's formula for the generalized Ising perceptron. Specializing the constraint terminal to the hard channel gives the Krauth--Mézard functional for the binary perceptron.
summary:
1. 针对高斯图样伊辛感知机的自由能，作者在正辅助表示及指数二次矩可积条件下，将软通道模型改写为二部高斯系统并实施构造性空腔递归。
2. 分块细化使核耦合的压强误差消失，所得有限级泛函以两侧方差乘积控制修正，复现Gardner公式且匹配既有软通道极小极大变分目标。
3. 该递归有望推广至多层感知机，但硬约束仅经终端特化处理，容量仍属副本对称分支预测。

title: Atomic Charge Chirality from Electric Multipoles
abstract: We establish an electric-multipole ($Q_{lm}$) criterion for chirality of local atomic charge distributions. For the 11 crystallographic chiral point groups, we identify representative lowest-rank multipole contents required to distinguish the opposite handednesses. For the axial groups $C_n$ and $D_n$ with $n=2,3,4,6$, chirality arises from the relative orientation of two azimuthal anisotropies with $m=n$, belonging to consecutive ranks $l=n$ and $n+1$. Their coexistence produces a latitude-dependent twist of the $n$-fold charge distribution. The polar component, although allowed in $C_n$, is distinct from this chiral mechanism and is not required for handedness. The cubic groups $T$ and $O$ exhibit distinct realizations, with octahedral chirality first appearing at rank nine. We further show that, within a spinless $s$-$p$-$d$-$f$ atomic basis, the scalar charge density contains multipoles only up to rank six and therefore cannot encode the handedness of $C_6$, $D_6$, or $O$. These results connect electric-multipole content and atomic orbital degrees of freedom to the microscopic encoding of crystallographic handedness.
summary:
1. 作者通过电多极展开、点群分析与轨道选择定则，确定11种晶体手性点群中局域标量电荷密度区分左右手性的最低阶条件。
2. 轴向群中m=n的n阶与n+1阶分量的相对取向决定纬度依赖的手性扭转，无需极性，O群则最低需九阶。
3. 判据可用于实测及第一性原理电荷密度分析，但无自旋单中心s–p–d–f基组的电荷多极上限为六阶，无法编码C₆、D₆或O的电荷手性。

title: Local Josephson response near nonmagnetic impurities and vortices in a two-orbital $s_{\pm}$ superconductor
abstract: We study the local Josephson response near nonmagnetic impurities and vortices in a self-consistent two-orbital $s_{\pm}$ superconductor. For a local $s$-wave tip that couples equally to the two orbitals, anomalous spectral contributions of opposite sign nearly cancel in the clean sample. Nonmagnetic impurities redistribute these contributions and can reverse the local coupling without a corresponding $\pi$ phase shift of the bond pair fields. Negative coupling appears at off-center sites at weaker impurity potentials than at the impurity site. The impurity-induced change is concentrated at lower quasiparticle energies, while states over a broader energy range contribute to the total clean and impurity couplings. In zero field, the coupling also changes sign as the tip gap is varied, and increasing the tunneling strength can reverse the $m=1$ sine component of the current without changing the sample state. At the chosen coherence-peak energy, increasing impurity strength mainly changes the relative intensities of existing quasiparticle-interference features. In a self-consistent two-vortex state, the Josephson response develops a spatially varying phase relative to the condensate. The response and condensate share the winding close to each core, while larger loops enclose additional winding of the Josephson response. The local Josephson sign and phase reflect the anomalous spectrum and the tip--sample coupling.
summary:
1. 作者自洽求解双轨道s±模型的BdG方程，以等权耦合两轨道的s波针尖计算非磁杂质及双涡旋附近的约瑟夫森响应，检验其能否直接表征配对场。
2. 杂质重分配近乎相消的反常谱贡献，可使耦合反号而键配对场无π相移、幅度至多改变约2.1%；涡旋态较大环路还出现相对凝聚态的额外响应绕数。
3. 这类约瑟夫森图像不能直接等同配对场，实验判别耦合符号需相位参照并考虑针尖参数，额外响应绕数不代表新增磁通涡旋。

title: Nodal magnon spin current at an antiferromagnet/altermagnet junction
abstract: We investigate the thermally driven magnon spin current across a junction between a $d$-wave altermagnet (AM) and a ferromagnet (FM) or an antiferromagnet (AFM). The current consists of a component independent of the interface angle and an angularly dependent component with the $d$-wave form. For a sublattice-symmetric interface, the two junctions behave oppositely under reversal of the altermagnetic domain: in the FM/AM junction the angularly dependent component is odd and cancels on averaging over the domains, whereas in the AFM/AM junction the angularly independent component vanishes by symmetry and the angularly dependent component survives the domain average at a fixed Néel vector of the AFM. Both follow from a selective tunneling: a pair of spins bonded across the interface transmits magnons when the spins are parallel and not when antiparallel, which makes the AFM/AM junction a magnon valve: the configuration in which the bonded spins are antiparallel blocks the current up to the sublattice admixture of the magnons. The anisotropic tunneling is detectable as the sign reversal of the current between the interfaces normal to $[310]$ and $[130]$, and the valve reads the Néel vector of the altermagnet relative to that of the antiferromagnet through the magnitude of the current at a fixed interface.
summary:
1. 作者以线性自旋波和Keldysh格林函数比较铁磁／交替磁与反铁磁／交替磁绝缘结，检验热驱动磁振子自旋流的界面各向异性能否经磁畴平均保留。
2. 界面耦合对子晶格对称且反铁磁奈尔矢量固定时，交替磁畴平均后仅反铁磁结保留d波分量，选择性隧穿使示例参数下阻断态自旋流幅值约为通态的2%。
3. 可用[310]与[130]界面自旋流反号检验各向异性，并有望据幅值读出相对奈尔取向，但等权反铁磁畴会抵消信号。

title: Polarization-locked chiral persistent spin textures in two-dimensional lead-halide perovskites
abstract: Chiral spacer cations crystallize two-dimensional hybrid perovskites in the polar Sohncke group $P2_1$, which places the polar axis in the inorganic layer. We analyze the spin-orbit field that this geometry allows and test it against first-principles spin textures of ten polar chiral lead-halide perovskites, their mirror enantiomers and four halide-substituted analogues. The point group $C_2$ with the twofold axis in the layer forbids the helical Rashba field and allows a linear term $\gamma_1 k_x \sigma_z$, the Rashba interaction of the in-plane polar axis, together with chirality-related Dresselhaus and radial terms. Thirty-four two-band $k \cdot p$ models were fitted to each band pair and ranked by the agreement of their spin directions with the calculation rather than by the band energies, which cannot distinguish them. In all strongly polar compounds, the conduction band is described by the persistent term alone, with $\gamma_1 = 1.09$-$1.98$ eV Å and a spin agreement of at least 0.98, whereas the best Rashba or Dresselhaus model reaches 0.20. The $R$ and $S$ enantiomers of each compound have opposite polarizations, and therefore opposite $\gamma_1$ and opposite persistent spin textures of equal magnitude, as required by the mirror that relates them; this holds in all ten compounds, so the choice of the enantiomer selects the spin direction. The magnitude of $\gamma_1$ correlates with the disparity of the in-plane Pb-X-Pb angles ($r = 0.95$). With electron masses of $0.26$-$0.43\,m_e$ along the spin-splitting directions, the associated persistent spin helices have wavelengths of 3.4-8.2 nm.
summary:
1. 作者结合对称性分析与第一性原理计算，按自旋方向而非能量筛选34种双带模型，考察手性二维铅卤钙钛矿中持久自旋纹理的机制及对映关系。
2. 强极性体系导带由面内极化对应的面外持久场主导，耦合强度为1.09–1.98 eV·Å、自旋方向吻合度≥0.98，两对映体的极化与纹理均反向。
3. 模型预言3.4–8.2纳米持久自旋螺旋，仍待单极化畴实验检验，电控自旋翻转能否实现则取决于尚未确定的极化反转势垒。

title: Ten-loop fixed-dimension renormalization-group functions of the three-dimensional O(N) model from distributed GPU-accelerated parametric integration
abstract:
The renormalization-group functions $ eta$, $\eta$ and $
u$ of the three-dimensional $O(N)$ model in fixed dimension (massive zero-momentum scheme) were known to eighth order in the coupling. We extend them to tenth order, and $ eta$ to eleventh, for general $N$, which requires the two- and four-point functions to ten loops (1,593,254 graphs at the last order), and re-evaluate all lower orders. Through the Callan-Symanzik equation every coefficient follows from per-order sums that are linear in finite, zero-momentum $ ar R$-subtracted parametric integrals, one per graph, which we sample on GPUs by tropical Monte Carlo with densities adapted to the forest terms. The computation reproduces the known sums from two to seven loops within three standard deviations and agrees at ninth and tenth order, at lower precision, with an independent route through an intermediate scheme. The new coefficients have relative uncertainties of a few $10^{-5}$ or better, and the eighth-order coefficients of $\eta$ and $
u$ improve by factors of 120 and 4. The time needed to integrate an order to fixed relative precision grows by only 2.4-2.9 per loop from seven loops on, while the construction of the integrands still grows factorially and, at tenth order, costs more than the integration. Resummed, the tenth-order series give $
u=0.62997(51)$, $\eta=0.0333(18)$ and $\omega=0.803(14)$ for $N=1$, against $0.62997097(12)$, $0.036297612(48)$ and $0.82968(23)$ from the conformal bootstrap; at $N=3$ the deviations grow, so that the uncertainty is now dominated by the resummation rather than by the coefficients. Every result is generated automatically from, or checked against, a public ledger of independent, exactly pooled runs, hosted on GitHub, to which anyone is welcome to contribute computing time.
summary:
1. 为计算三维O(N)模型的临界指数，作者将定维重整化群系数归结为森林公式减除后的有限参数积分，并用分布式GPU热带蒙特卡洛求值。
2. η、ν的耦合展开达十阶、β达十一阶，N=1新系数相对不确定度不超过4×10⁻⁵，七圈起等相对精度求积耗时逐圈约为前阶的2.4–2.9倍。
3. 被积函数构造仍呈阶乘增长，指数精度则受重求和系统误差限制，N=3的ω偏离蒙特卡洛基准，后续需检验固定点非解析性的影响。

title: A Zoo of Fermionic Relative Rényi Negativities in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Models
abstract: Quantum entanglement is a fundamental resource that gives rise to correlations with no classical counterpart in strongly correlated fermionic systems. However, its characterization in mixed quantum states remains challenging. Established entanglement diagnostics, such as logarithmic negativity, are computationally demanding in interacting systems, and their evaluation by exact diagonalization is restricted to small system sizes. Meanwhile, conventional Rényi proxies, including twisted and untwisted Rényi negativities, can be positive even for separable states. In this work, we introduce a family of \textit{relative Rényi negativities} that serve as entanglement witnesses. By relating fermionic partial time reversal to the size superoperator, we establish a path-integral representation for these Rényi negativities, enabling their evaluation in thermal states of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model and its generalizations via a large-$N$ expansion. Applying this method, we investigate entanglement in both the original SYK model and the Maldacena-Qi coupled SYK model. We identify a special class of relative Rényi negativities which serve as plausible proxies for logarithmic negativity and uncover first-order entanglement transitions that are invisible to simple observables. These results highlight the utility of relative Rényi negativities as probes of mixed-state entanglement in strongly correlated fermionic systems and suggest the existence of a new class of transitions where these negativities serve as free energies.
summary:
1. 为诊断费米混态纠缠，作者构造相对Rényi负性，利用部分时间反演与算符大小超算符的联系建立路径积分，并以大N展开研究原始与耦合SYK热态。
2. 这些量非负且在可分态上为零，原始模型中副本鞍点竞争产生常规观测不可见的一阶转变，耦合模型在弱耦合区则出现两次相继转变。
3. 最小偏离交替序列的一类量在原始模型的二、四、六阶计算中随升温单调减小，有望代理对数负性，但其普适性仍待检验。

title: Metastability, collective excitations, and traveling states of one-dimensional spin-orbit-coupled quantum droplets
abstract: We study the static and traveling droplet phases of spin-orbit coupled, one-dimensional Bose-Bose mixtures with a Lee-Huang-Yang correction. For the static droplets, employing a variational analysis for an infinitely extended mixture, we show that the system can feature two ground-state droplet phases: a stripe droplet phase up to a critical Rabi coupling strength, at which it undergoes a first-order transition to a zero-momentum droplet phase. The variational results for the ground-state properties are shown to be in good agreement with numerical solutions for droplets in the thermodynamic limit as well as finite-size droplets in the "flat-top regime". For finite-size droplets, the stripe phase can feature multiple stationary states with different numbers of peaks in their stripe density patterns. The calculation of the excitation spectrum for these stationary states confirms their stability. To study the moving droplets, we investigate the ground-state phases of the system in the droplet's comoving frame. We show that in the comoving frame, droplets acquire a finite longitudinal magnetization. As a consequence, the phase diagram features two distinct phases: a traveling stripe droplet and a plane-wave droplet. The real-time evolution of these droplets in the space-fixed frame, complemented by the Bogoliubov analysis in the comoving frame, illustrates the stability of these traveling droplet phases.
summary:
1. 作者结合含局域LHY修正的变分、GP演化与BdG分析，研究一维自旋轨道耦合双组分量子液滴的有限尺寸亚稳性及行进稳定性。
2. 所考察参数下存在条纹至零动量的一阶转变，而条纹区基态谱的跳变源于不同条纹数稳定分支的能量交叉，并非动力学失稳。
3. 计算支持具有纵向磁化的条纹及平面波液滴稳定传播，但完全自束缚受临界速度限制，预测依赖相互作用能主导的局域LHY近似。

title: Aging and protocol dependence of thermal activation events in structural glasses
abstract: In this study, we investigate the waiting time dependence and the protocol dependence of thermally activated events in structural glasses using molecular simulations and potential energy landscape analysis. We find a qualitative crossover in the nature of activation events; from avalanche-like events to local events. We also use the isoconfigurational ensemble analysis and reveal that the events become less diverse and more reversible. We discuss these crossovers from the perspective of the stability and the potential energy landscape of glasses. To investigate the protocol dependence, we compare the two types of glasses whose stability is controlled by waiting time and parent temperature, respectively. Surprisingly, at the same inherent structure energy level, the parent-temperature-controlled glasses are more unstable and maintain their avalanche-like nature. These results demonstrate that the activation properties of structural glasses are not determined solely by their energy levels, highlighting the essential role of state connectivity and the dynamical sampling in the complex energy landscape.
summary:
1. 作者结合二维二元玻璃的分子动力学、固有结构追踪及等构型系综，比较等待时间与母液温度调控对热激活重排的影响。
2. 等待约百个约化时间单位后，事件尺寸分布由含幂律段变为近指数分布，重排趋于局域且可逆性增强；同固有结构能量下，所测母液温度调控样品仍更易激活并保留雪崩性。
3. 结果表明能量并非充分的稳定性指标，提示需考察景观连通性与动态采样；跨事件促发形成热雪崩的可能性仍待验证。

title: Hop rates of H and D on Pt(111) at finite coverage: the memory equation and the collective friction
abstract: Helium scattering measures the coherent intermediate scattering function of an adlayer, the characteristic function of the separation between adparticles at two times. Published dephasing rates of H and D on Pt(111) are analysed with its memory equation and a nearest-neighbour Ising lattice gas. The measured rate belongs to the adlayer. The hop rate of a single adsorbate is extracted from it by dividing out an interaction factor, without a model of the barrier. This factor lies between $0.97$ and $1.17$ at $0.1$~ML, so that the published single-adsorbate analyses hold there. At $0.4$~ML and $80$~K it lies between $1.2$ and $4.7$, depending on how the occupied neighbours modify a tunnelling jump. The memory function is interpreted as a friction, the collective friction, which the adlayer exerts on its own density fluctuations. The lateral coupling, fixed by the coverage series, is the free energy of a neighbouring pair, with a vibrational pair entropy. The small deformation of the measured curves from the Chudley--Elliott form, the tilt, is proposed as an observable of the coupling. The tilts at $0.15$ and $0.2$~ML are consistent with it, although they are hard to extract from the published curves. The memory equation provides a transition-state theory for the adlayer, with the collective friction in the role of the friction of the substrate and without divergence at the crossover. Combined with the standard quantum transition-state theory of a single adsorbate, the extracted hop rates give the friction of the substrate, $124$ and $75$~ps$^{-1}$ for H and D, independent of the coverage.
summary:
1. 为从有限覆盖度的集体退相干提取孤立原子总跳跃率，作者结合记忆方程、近邻伊辛晶格气及动力学蒙特卡罗，重析Pt(111)上氢、氘的氦散射数据。
2. 该分解无需势垒模型即可区分单原子动力学与集体摩擦，80 K时两种跳跃规则预测的节点修正因子在0.1单层为0.97—1.17、0.4单层为1.18—4.67。
3. 低温校正仍依赖外推，高覆盖度测量可约束隧穿规则，而长波长完整衰减测量可追查近邻模型未解释的低覆盖度额外曲线形变。

title: Itô versus Stratonovich for shot noise with state-dependent amplitude: why the answer is Marcus
abstract: For Gaussian white noise the Itô and Stratonovich prescriptions differ by $O(dt)$ per time step, which accumulates into the familiar spurious drift $\tfrac12 D\,II'$. We show that for renewal shot noise with state-dependent gain, $\dot x=-C(x)-I(x)\xi[t]$ with $\xi[t]$ a train of Dirac spikes of finite random amplitude, the two prescriptions differ by a finite amount at every event, and that where $I$ vanishes the difference can become qualitative. The Marcus kick, the jump-process counterpart of the Stratonovich prescription, is the flow map of $dx/ds=I(x)$: no kick can cross a zero $x^\ast$ of $I$, for any jump and waiting-time statistics. The Itô kick is only the tangent map of that flow. For $I(x)=1+\beta x$ it crosses $x^\ast=-1/\beta$ if and only if $\xi\beta>1$ and collapses the whole line onto $x^\ast$ at $\xi\beta=1$; below threshold it is itself a Marcus kick with a remapped jump law. Bounded jump laws thus have a threshold, while unbounded ones leak across the barrier for \emph{any} parameters. The discrepancy cannot be absorbed into a renormalised drift beyond lowest order, and only the Marcus kick is generated by a single operator, which makes the master equation of Bianucci, Bologna and Mannella (2026) intrinsically Marcus. Numerically, the standard Heun kick is a second-order truncation of the Marcus map that preserves the barrier only because its order is even; it shortens every jump, biasing second moments in proportion to the squared jump amplitude and the jump kurtosis, and depleting the region near the barrier. We give the exact-flow integrator that replaces it.
summary:
1. 针对状态依赖散粒噪声中有限跃迁的积分歧义，作者结合脉冲正则化、跃迁算符和蒙特卡洛模拟比较Itô与Marcus规则，并给出精确流积分器。
2. Marcus跃迁不跨越增益零点，而线性增益I(x)=1+βx下Itô在ξβ=1时使分布塌缩至零点、ξβ>1时越界；二值脉冲±a、aβ=0.5的模拟中Heun二阶矩偏低约8%。
3. 脉宽远短于弛豫时间且增益连续响应时宜采用精确Marcus流映射，而按事件前状态确定跃迁大小的离散模型仍可使用Itô。

title: Multiple Current Enhancement Regimes and Interaction Induced Re-entrant Transport in a Quasiperiodic Hubbard Ring with Antiferromagnetic Order
abstract: We investigate persistent charge and spin currents in a one-dimensional quantum ring threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm (AB) flux, considering generalized Aubry-André-Harper (AAH) modulation with staggered onsite energies and antiferromagnetic (AFM) ordering in both the noninteracting and interacting regimes, with the latter treated using a self-consistent Hartree-Fock mean field theory (MFT). At half filling, two distinct current-enhancement peaks emerge as the modulation strength increases, with quasiperiodic hopping modulation playing a crucial role in establishing the two-peak structure within a restricted parameter regime.
