Finally, we propose a correspondence with the generalized families of quantum field theories of Brennan and Intriligator, in which equivariant families correspond to Type~I pairs and categorical ones to Type~II pairs whose gauging preserves the symmetry, family anomalies appear as universes carrying different symmetry-protected topological phases, and Type~III pairs can realize families over a discrete parameter. An appendix by Xingyang Yu works out the higher-charge Schwinger model as a Lagrangian example.
summary:
1. 作者以多重融合范畴及作用函子刻画二维分解量子场论的有限对称性，按所选对称性内拓扑界面的存在性与可逆性分类宇宙对。
2. 作者导出所考察的含平凡作用阿贝尔正规子群轨形的全部继承对称性，证明其中不出现无界面类型，并按规范化是否改变对称范畴细分非可逆类型。
3. 据此提出离散广义理论族的分解描述，可逆族的反常可由宇宙间对称保护拓扑相的差异匹配，而连续参数族仍超出当前有限框架。

title: The Effective Field Theory Origin of the Fuzzy Sphere Method
abstract: Fuzzy sphere Hamiltonians for (2+1)D conformal field theories are usually written directly on the lowest Landau level. We introduce a framework organizing them as descendants of local ``mother theories'' on $S^2\times\mathbb R$. We start with the example of Ising mother theory built from two charged Dirac fermions coupled to a real mediator $\phi$. Integrating out $\phi$ and the higher Landau levels produces the fuzzy Hamiltonian, while integrating out the fermions gives a conventional local $\phi$ effective field theory flowing to the Ising point. Mild modifications of the same theory reach the Gaussian point (tricritical route) and the Lee-Yang continuation. Exploring the space of mother theories, we next promote $\phi$ to a complex field $\Phi$ and construct a new example, whose descendant is an easy-plane ferromagnet on the fuzzy sphere. Its spontaneous symmetry breaking phase gives a pseudo-Goldstone relativistic scalar, similar to the model introduced by Y.-C. He, while its critical point is non-relativistic, providing the first example of $z=2$ scaling on the fuzzy sphere. Remarkably, it admits exact one-magnon solutions, and the $z=2$ critical point can be found analytically. We then outline a rich landscape of further applications of our approach.
summary:
1. 为厘清模糊球模型的场论起源，作者在磁通球面上构建带电狄拉克费米子与中性标量的局域母理论，通过不同积分消元路径连接最低朗道能级哈密顿量与标量有效场论。
2. 磁通诱导的贝里项使易平面铁磁体的饱和转变在固定磁场的热力学极限呈z=2标度，非负双赝势下的单磁振子精确谱与正性证明排除了多磁振子抢先失稳。
3. 这一反例说明洛伦兹对称性并非必然涌现，而母理论框架向有隙场论的推广仍待具体实现。

title: Unifying energy-entropy bounds in semiclassical gravity
abstract: We revisit bounds on energy and entropy in semiclassical gravity, aiming to strengthen and unify established bounds, in particular the quantum focussing conjecture (QFC) and the smeared null energy condition (SNEC). Both the QFC and SNEC have important applications and are the strongest in their respective hierarchies; however, neither implies the other, nor reduces to the null energy condition (NEC) in the classical limit. To that end, we define a new class of bounds dubbed gravitational energy-entropy conditions (GEECs) that imply both the QFC and SNEC, and reduce to the NEC classically. We construct an explicit family of GEECs by imposing the defining criteria on a broad set of stress tensor bounds, and constrain its remaining parameter space through test cases, in an effective field theory-inspired approach. Our GEECs are powerful candidate bounds on energy and entropy in semiclassical gravity.
summary:
1. 为统一半经典引力中的能量与熵界，作者用经典和量子膨胀率参数化应力张量下界，构造单参数候选族及其扩展，并以球区真空纠缠熵检验。
2. 候选界同时蕴含量子聚焦猜想与展宽零能量条件，经典极限还原零能量条件，但四维共形场论真空球区检验排除了整个单参数族，扩展族仍有参数未被排除。
3. 这些界尚未获证且依赖重整化方案，需以非真空态或全息模型继续检验，并探索方案无关的构造。

title: Collective Bootstrap for Matrix Quantum Mechanics
abstract: We develop a collective bootstrap framework for large $N$ matrix quantum mechanics formulated directly in the loop space of single trace coordinate moments. Loop joining and splitting operations organize the kinetic constraints systematically and avoid treating momentum containing moments as independent variables. Employing the virial theorem, a Schur complement, and a relaxation of quadratic products of loops, we recast the nonlinear constrained optimization of the collective energy into a semidefinite program, which yields a lower bound on the planar ground state energy at every truncation. A sequential semidefinite optimization heuristic then searches for configurations satisfying planar factorization and estimates the ground state energy and loop expectation values. Applications to one-, two-, and three-matrix models exhibit close agreement with analytic solutions and master field optimization. By working exclusively with coordinate moments, the framework permits truncations at higher word length and offers a promising approach to models with more matrices, including the bosonic sectors of the BFSS and BMN models.
summary:
1. 为求大N矩阵量子力学的平面基态，作者仅以坐标单迹矩为变量，结合环拼接与劈裂、维里定理及Schur补构建半定规划自举。
2. 松弛最优值给出各截断的能量下界，单矩阵算例的能量估计吻合精确解至六位有效数字，三矩阵杨–米尔斯能量估计在人工矩上界下与主场结果相差0.022%。
3. 秩一搜索仍不保证全局最优，更高阶动力学约束可望改善矩估计，推广至BFSS与BMN玻色扇区仍待验证。

title: Elliptic master integrals and the one-loop cosmological wavefunction
abstract: Loop corrections to the cosmological wavefunction involve similar integrals to those required for scattering amplitudes. For the one-loop triangle of a conformally coupled scalar, the master integrals are elliptic, and so the triangle wavefunction coefficient was expected to be elliptic as well. Using a bootstrap approach, we compute this triangle coefficient exactly and show that it is not: the elliptic periods cancel, and the flat-space wavefunction coefficient is a combination of dilogarithms. The cancellation occurs because the residue of the loop integrand on the elliptic sector is a flat-space amplitude, rational in the loop momentum. The one-loop box, by contrast, is not polylogarithmic, even with a single external leg at each site. Its threshold discontinuity involves elliptic integrals, which we also give in closed form. For regular-tetrahedron momenta the periods of a K3 surface enter its loop integrand.
summary:
1. 为确定宇宙学单圈波函数系数的函数空间，作者结合精确微分方程与高精度数值自举，求得共形耦合标量的平直时空三角图系数并分析盒图。
2. 三角图被积函数的椭圆扇区留数为有理散射振幅，使周期抵消、系数化为权重二的多重对数；盒图阈值不连续度则含不可消去的椭圆积分。
3. 结果说明主积分可能高估物理量的函数空间，三角图闭式可为膨胀背景提供积分核，但顶点接多条外腿时能量积分能否保持多重对数结构仍待确定。

title: From pq-webs to magnetic quivers and back I: dictionary and deformations
abstract: This is the first of two companion papers in which we study five-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ theories engineered by $(p,q)$ five-brane webs and their associated three-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=4$ magnetic quivers. We focus on the $N+\mathrm{SU}(N)_0^{k-1}+N$ box quiver theories. We propose an exact parameter dictionary relating the five-dimensional flavour masses and instanton couplings to the Fayet-Iliopoulos parameters of the corresponding strong-coupling magnetic quiver. We test this dictionary through a broad class of deformations, including mass deformations, weak-coupling limits, and vacuum expectation values. On the five-dimensional side, we implement these flows directly at the level of the superconformal index. The dictionary fixes the corresponding FI deformations and monopole VEVs. We analyse them in the magnetic-quiver squashed-sphere partition function using a new method that tracks Higgsing, decoupled sectors, and infrared theories. Our results promote magnetic quivers to tools for the quantitative study of how the five-dimensional superconformal index responds to deformations. Once the parameter dictionary is known, exact three-dimensional observables can be used to reconstruct the corresponding five-dimensional physics and to navigate the full deformation network in both directions.
summary:
1. 为刻画五维盒形理论的形变如何映射到三维磁箭图，作者比较超共形指标与压扁三球面配分函数，提出质量和瞬子参数到FI参数的精确可逆字典。
2. NS5膜移除、弱耦合及味解耦的两侧计算给出相符的红外参数和解耦扇区，新方法还通过渐近相位区分真空并对简并贡献求和。
3. 三维分析经字典反推出D5膜移除的五维参数流，为研究需瞬子重求和的形变提供途径，但该流尚无五维指标的直接检验。

title: From pq-webs to magnetic quivers and back II: distributional indices and 5d theories breaking bad
abstract: This is the second of two companion papers in which we study five-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ theories engineered by $(p,q)$ five-brane webs and their associated three-dimensional magnetic quivers. Leveraging the exact parameter dictionary between the $N+\mathrm{SU}(N)_0^{k-1}+N$ theories and their magnetic quivers at infinite coupling, proposed in the first paper, we investigate nilpotent moment-map VEV deformations and their three-dimensional counterparts. We show that, when the Higgsing is excessive, the five-dimensional superconformal index becomes distributional, mirroring a characteristic feature of bad and broken theories in three dimensions. We also develop a five-brane web interpretation of these results, identifying the Hanany-Witten moves associated with the Higgsing cascade and relating inequivalent frames to distinct tessellations of the generalised toric diagram.
summary:
1. 作者借助前篇提出的无限耦合处精确参数字典，研究(p,q)五膜网构造的五维𝒩=1理论的矩映射幂零真空期望值变形及其三维磁性箭图对应。
2. 过度希格斯化使五维超共形指标成为分布，呈现与三维“坏”及“破缺”理论相呼应的特征。
3. 希格斯化级联对应Hanany–Witten移动，不等价框架关联广义环面图的不同剖分，为理解五维—三维对应中的变形提供了几何线索。

title: Holography and localization in fractional field theory
abstract: Fractional field theory is a promising framework wherein to quantize the gravitational interaction but the presence of nonlocal operators can make its handling difficult. With the purpose of easing this problem, we recast the theory as a local dual in two ways. First, we generalize the Caffarelli--Silvestre extension theorem to self-adjoint fractional field theories with multi-scale kinetic terms and nonlocal interactions, taking the example of a scalar field. The latter is reinterpreted as a nonlocal boundary degree of freedom holographically dual to a local theory of two scalars living in a higher-dimensional bulk. However, inclusion of a local non-linear potential is not straightforward. We therefore propose an alternative picture where the nonlocal theory is not extended to a higher-dimensional space but is localized at the price of introducing a continuum of masses. This \emph{spectral localization} allows for a natural implementation of the fakeon prescription and the related classicization procedure, already employed in local theories with higher-derivative and complex ghosts. Applications to fractional quantum gravity and its comparison with quadratic quantum gravity are discussed.
summary:
1. 针对分数阶场论的非局域性，作者在含多尺度动能与非局域相互作用的标量模型中推广延拓定理，并构建基于预解算符的谱局域表示。
2. 动能项对应高一维双标量理论，同维连续质量辅助场方案则容纳局域非线性势，并在逐质量施加fakeon处方后积分，导出树级经典化拉格朗日量。
3. 该框架为分数阶量子引力的经典化提供工具，但引力中的具体实现及更高圈检验尚待完成。

title: Gravitational Reconstruction in $AdS_{4}$
abstract: We reconstruct linearized gravitational perturbations in $AdS_{4}$ from a conserved, traceless stress tensor on a fixed conformally flat boundary metric, extending our earlier real Lorentzian construction. For admissible data with no spacelike Fourier support in a flat conformal frame, the physical response reduces to an integral over boundary light-cone cuts. Boundary improvements restore Fefferman--Graham (FG) gauge while preserving normalizability and the linearized Weyl tensor. We then reconstruct perturbations with general spacelike boundary momentum, including nonzero frequency and its zero-frequency limit, using explicit position-space generalized functions on real stress data. Boundary kernels are constructed for normalizable perturbations and sufficient conditions are derived for the reconstruction to converge. The results motivate controlled flat-space limits relevant to Bondi--Metzner--Sachs symmetries and celestial holography.
summary:
1. 作者在固定共形平坦边界度规下，用实坐标核及FG规范补偿，由守恒无迹应力张量重建AdS₄线性引力扰动。
2. 给出含零频类空模的可归一化核及指数谱收敛条件，并证明普通光锥截面分布不能普遍恢复光滑全局源的FG度规，缺失贡献可为纯规范项。
3. 该框架可为BMS及天球全息的平直极限检验提供工具，但可归一化不保证内部正则，极限中的渐近数据与荷仍待计算。

title: Generalized Symmetries of QED$_4$ on Non-Spin Manifolds
abstract: Generalized symmetries are sensitive to the tangential structure of spacetime. We study this interplay for massless QED on oriented non-spin four-manifolds, where the photon becomes a spin$^c$ connection and the path integral sums over spin$^c$ structures. The shifted flux quantization extends the magnetic 1-form symmetry into a $w_2$-twisted 1-form symmetry: its $2\pi$ rotation acts as a gravitational sign, fixed by the normal bundle of the surface the operator wraps. The obstruction to treating it as an ordinary magnetic 1-form symmetry is an order-two mixed magnetic-gravitational anomaly, which is classified by reduced oriented bordism and detected on the Wu manifold. In a fixed spin$^c$ sector, this anomaly is removable by a counterterm, so it is a property of the sum over spin$^c$ structures. We discuss its consequences for gapped, Coulomb, and Higgs phases. The chiral anomaly is governed by the index of the spin$^c$ Dirac operator, so rational chiral defects carry gravitational as well as electromagnetic responses. A spin$^c$ Hall topological field theory cancels the electromagnetic part but leaves a framing anomaly. At the level of anomaly inflow, this is canceled for every rational angle by stacking a neutral, generally noninvertible Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev layer. The same framing subtlety affects the chiral defects of QED on curved spin manifolds. The complex projective plane illustrates each of these features explicitly.
summary:
1. 作者在定向非自旋四维流形上，以spin^c联络描述光子并对spin^c结构求和，研究无质量QED的广义对称性如何依赖时空切向结构。
2. 磁通量子化偏移使磁一形式对称性受w₂扭曲，其Z₂型磁—引力混合反常在固定spin^c扇区可由反项消除，表明反常源于结构求和。
3. 叠加中性、通常非可逆的WRT拓扑层可在反常流入层面抵消任意有理角手征缺陷的残余标架反常，提示弯曲时空中的缺陷构造须兼顾引力响应。

title: Are Black Hole and Cosmological Horizon Thermodynamics Necessarily Inequivalent?
abstract: It has recently been argued that cosmological horizon thermodynamics and black hole thermodynamics are generically inequivalent in any consistent, UV complete theory of quantum gravity, where it was suggested that this could be falsified by the identification of a counterexample. This conjecture was motivated in part by noting that cosmological horizons do not incorporate many of the convenient features found in the black holes described by string theory. In this work, we consider as a toy model a universe with a single non-rotating black hole and a positive cosmological constant. We work in the Nariai limit where the mass of the black hole is taken to its maximum possible value, and where we also assert that the quantum field theory living on this background is strictly parity invariant. In the semi-classical regime where we neglect instability of the exact Nariai equilibrium under quantum fluctuations, we find that the observer cannot readily distinguish the physics in the neighborhood of the black hole horizon from the physics in the neighborhood of the cosmological horizon. This does not prove that the two are generically equivalent in any universe, though it does suggest that they cannot be entirely unrelated in general. We propose that any consistent theory of quantum gravity that aims to describe black holes in a universe with a positive cosmological constant should provide a related microscopic origin for the leading semiclassical cosmological entropy and black hole entropy in the neighborhood of the particular limit considered here.
summary:
1. 为探究黑洞与宇宙学视界热力学能否等价，作者假设量子场论严格宇称不变，分析施瓦西–德西特黑洞最大质量的Nariai极限。
2. 反射对称性互换两视界，其面积、熵、霍金温度及标量吸收系数相同，使半经典近视界物理对观察者不可区分。
3. 该特例可为两类视界熵的微观理论提供一致性检验，但分析忽略量子涨落失稳，未证明微观起源相同或紫外完备理论中的普遍等价。

title: Deformed Amplituhedra and Interpolating Anomalous Dimensions on the Coulomb Branch
abstract: We study planar four-point scattering amplitudes on the Coulomb branch of $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory, focusing on multi-parameter families of massive kinematics. We extend the deformed Amplituhedron construction of \cite{Arkani-Hamed:2023epq,Flieger:2025ekn} to general external kinematics characterized by a six-parameter embedding-space Gram matrix. We show that copositivity constraints on the inverse Gram matrix control the real geometry and restrict the numerator of the two-loop canonical form to the span of the two planar double-box structures expected for the scattering amplitude. We then specialize to a three-parameter massive configuration and evaluate the relevant one- and two-loop integrals using differential equations directly in four dimensions, obtaining analytic expressions in terms of multiple polylogarithms. We investigate multiscale infrared limits of the proposed two-loop amplitude and find exponentiation through two loops. The kinematic family contains the limits governed by the cusp and octagon anomalous dimensions and interpolates between them through the walking anomalous dimension introduced in~\cite{Alday:2026cpk}. Our result reproduces the one-loop interpolation and fixes the two-loop coefficients in their proposed all-loop ansatz. Interestingly, our results suggest that the walking anomalous dimension may be entirely determined through all loop orders by the cusp and octagon anomalous dimensions.
summary:
1. 为研究平面N=4超杨–米尔斯理论库仑支四点振幅的几何与红外结构，作者以六参数格拉姆矩阵推广变形振幅几何，并用四维有限微分方程解析计算三参数族的一、两圈积分。
2. 逆格拉姆矩阵的共正性条件将两圈分子限于两种平面双盒结构；在双盒归一化假设下，红外发散至两圈指数化，并确定插值系数γ⁽²⁾=γ̃⁽²⁾=−4ζ₂。
3. 两圈结果提示行走反常维数的全圈表达式可能仅由尖点与八边形反常维数决定，但这一猜想仍待高圈计算检验。

title: Regularized Master-Field Approximation for Mass-Deformed Supersymmetric Yang-Mills Matrix Models
abstract: The regularized master-field approximation (RMA) is an efficient computational method for large-$N$ reduced matrix models, including those with multiple matrices or complex integration weights. In this work, we apply the RMA to mass-deformed supersymmetric Yang--Mills-type matrix models with three, four, and ten matrices. All three models admit fuzzy-sphere configurations as classical solutions. We show that the RMA quantitatively reproduces these fuzzy-sphere solutions and their breakdown, and that zero modes of the Dirac operator can destabilize fuzzy-sphere configurations in certain cases.
summary:
1. 作者积分消去费米子，以正则化主场近似最小化有限组大N环路方程残差，研究三、四及十矩阵质量形变超对称杨–米尔斯型模型中模糊球的量子稳定性。
2. 约10阶正则化矩阵即可再现模糊球并捕捉其失稳迹象，同时揭示三矩阵模型中狄拉克零模可诱发球构型失稳。
3. 该方法为复权重模型提供互补计算途径，但相变临界点尚未可靠定位，现有优化在无质量极限失效。

title: virasoro_blocks: Software for the 2d bootstrap
abstract: We introduce virasoro_blocks, software that computes Virasoro conformal blocks at any central charge in a form suitable for the numerical bootstrap. At each finite order in the elliptic nome, Zamolodchikov's recursion gives the block as a positive prefactor times a rational function of the exchanged weight. However, its many Kac poles make it difficult to use in semidefinite programming approaches to the bootstrap. In this software we use optimal interpolation to reduce the number of poles while keeping high accuracy. The software works in arbitrary precision and handles singular central charges, including the minimal models and $c=1$. It also computes global blocks, $N=1$ superconformal blocks, torus characters, and torus one-point blocks. We illustrate it with two applications. Assuming only scalar Virasoro primaries, we compute bounds on the scalar gap that approach the window of Liouville solutions between $(c-1)/16$ and $(c-1)/12$. We also bound the average exchanged dimension in four-point functions of identical scalars at several central charges. These bounds have a rich structure, and many known 2d CFTs lie on or near their boundary.
summary:
1. 为以半定规划约束二维共形场论谱，作者开发任意精度Virasoro块软件，以最优插值缩减保留的Kac极点，并用洛朗展开处理奇异中心荷。
2. 代表性块值测试仅留48个极点便达10⁻⁴⁰以下误差，初级谱纯标量且外场最轻时的隙界逼近Liouville窗口，多种已知理论接近或饱和平均交换维数界。
3. 联合球面交叉与模不变性有望检验候选谱，但现有数值界仍受截断误差及有限的高自旋正性检查限制。

title: Ortho-symplectic interface line operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM theories
abstract: We study the line operators at the half-BPS interfaces in 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills (SYM) theories of orthogonal and symplectic gauge groups. For the NS5-type interfaces, line operators are labeled by pairs of electric or magnetic charges under the gauge groups on either side of the interface, whereas for the D5-type interfaces they are labeled by electric or magnetic charges under the single gauge group preserved by the interface. We propose dualities between the Wilson lines and vortex lines at the interfaces under the action of S-duality. As highly non-trivial evidence of the dualities on the junctions of the line operators and the interfaces, we find matching of the line defect half-indices for the dual pairs.
summary:
1. 作者研究四维N=4正交与辛超杨–米尔斯理论的半BPS界面线算符，提出Wilson线与涡旋线的S对偶，并用线缺陷半指标检验。
2. NS5型线算符以两侧规范群的成对电荷或磁荷标记，D5型以保留的单一规范群的荷标记，所提对偶线对的半指标相符。
3. 这一匹配为线与界面交汇处的对偶提供证据，但完整线算符对应仍需超出半指标匹配的独立检验。

title: Schwinger--Keldysh worldline effective field theory for quantum black holes: dissipation, noise and decoherence
abstract: We formulate a Schwinger--Keldysh worldline effective field theory for quantum black holes that treats dissipation, fluctuations, and decoherence within one real-time influence functional. The reduced dynamics is encoded in causal response and symmetric noise kernels. Their spectra obey positivity constraints, while thermal Kubo--Martin--Schwinger symmetry relates them through the fluctuation--dissipation relation. A Hubbard--Stratonovich representation turns the noise kernel into a Gaussian source driving the resolved metric and worldline. For a leading post-Newtonian Schwarzschild binary, direct and metric-mediated stochastic forces combine into the complete relative-acceleration noise at this order, preserve center-of-mass momentum balance, and remain Planck suppressed. The same noise kernel gives the quadrupolar decoherence functional for a supported spatial superposition and reproduces the Danielson--Satishchandran--Wald horizon-induced scaling after absorptive matching. Away from thermal equilibrium, response and noise remain independent matching data. We discuss extensions to microscopic quantum structure in the worldline kernels, matching to spatially extended coarse-grained descriptions, and gravitational splitting.
summary:
1. 为厘清黑洞吸收、涨落与退相干的联系，作者沿闭合时间路径积分掉内部多极自由度，建立含因果响应核与对称噪声核的世界线有效场论。
2. 史瓦西双星热噪声的最低后牛顿阶计算纳入度规介导力并保持质心动量平衡，等质量时相对加速度噪声协方差为固定度规近似的四倍，仍受普朗克抑制。
3. 同一噪声核重现视界诱导退相干标度，提示吸收与干涉有望互补探查黑洞涨落，但非热态噪声仍须独立匹配。

title: Quantum field theory with scale-dependent weighted measures: nonlinear momentum representations, vacuum fluctuations, and causal structure
abstract: We reconsider the construction of free quantum fields through momentum-space weighted measures, introducing an independent energy scale that restores the conventional theory at low momenta. The resulting family is characterized by a dimensionless spectral function and includes, as a distinguished case, the spatial weight associated with the Euclidean Snyder algebra. We discuss its relation to modified dispersion relations and nonlinear momentum coordinates, and introduce an observer-covariant spectral weight defined using a timelike four-velocity. For the complex Klein-Gordon field we obtain the equal-time algebra, conserved weighted observables, vacuum fluctuations, and two-point functions in arbitrary spatial dimension. The ultraviolet conditions for their finiteness are established, and the nonlocal causal structure is analyzed in terms of a spatial convolution of the ordinary Pauli-Jordan distribution. An illustrative interacting extension and numerical profiles of the kernels and amplitudes are also presented.
summary:
1. 为软化紫外奇异性，作者在复克莱因–戈尔登场中引入含独立尺度Λ的动量谱权重，保留通常低能极限与自由色散，解析推导对易代数及两点函数。
2. 在D维空间，权重F(k)=(1+k²/Λ²)^{-r/2}取r>D+1时使加权真空能密度有限，但空间滤波留下指数抑制却非零的类空对易子尾。
3. 滤波真空能有限并未消除正则哈密顿量的真空发散；一圈蝌蚪图虽已收敛，相互作用的全阶有限性与幺正性仍待检验。

title: Does SO(2,2) symmetry lead to an additional U(1) symmetry in 5-dimensional Einstein-scalar theories?
abstract: Solving Einstein equations including the matter fields in dimensions higher than four is computationally challenging. However, the existence of symmetries facilitates these calculations. Among these symmetries, we can mention the SO(2,2) symmetry that arises in the near-horizon geometries of extremal black holes with vanishing horizon area in four dimensions \cite{EVH/CFT} and higher dimensions \cite{Sadeghian:2015}. Solutions of Einstein theories including scalar and Maxwell fields with SO(2,2) symmetry have been classified in four, five, and higher dimensions \cite{Sadeghian:2014}. For the Einstein-Maxwell-Lambda theory, a theorem states that SO(2,2) symmetry leads to an additional U(1) symmetry and therefore unique axisymmetric solutions. Nevertheless, in the presence of a scalar field, this symmetry group is not large enough in five dimensions to guarantee solution uniqueness, and the additional U(1) symmetry remains a conjecture in \cite{Sadeghian:2014}. Here, we study the Einstein equations of theories with a five-dimensional scalar field using the Lie symmetry method for solving partial differential equations. We challenge the conjecture in \cite{Sadeghian:2014} and find a solution that depends on both $\theta$ and $\psi$ coordinates as a counterexample to that conjecture.
summary:
1. 为检验SO(2,2)是否必然蕴含额外U(1)等距对称，作者在五维爱因斯坦–无质量标量理论中采用可分离假设，以李对称法降阶求解场方程。
2. 所得解同时依赖两个横向坐标，与既有轴对称解相差非恒定共形因子，原轴向平移仅为共形而非等距对称，为对称增强猜想提供反例。
3. 该解在ψ=0存在曲率奇点，其能否作为零视界面积极端黑洞的近视界几何仍待研究。

title: Absorption of bound supernova axion-like particles by the neutron star weakens the heating limits on their photon coupling
abstract: Axion-like particles (ALPs) that couple to protons are produced in a core-collapse supernova, and the slow ones remain bound to the new neutron star. Bose, Ganguly, Kumar, and Raj [ arXiv:2610.30255 ] proposed that the photons from the decay of this bound cloud reheat old neutron stars, and they derived strong limits on the ALP-photon coupling. They neglected the absorption of the ALPs by the star, but a bound ALP on an orbit that enters the star and reaches 50 km crosses it about $6\times 10^{18}$ times over the 333 Myr age of PSR J2144$-$3933. We show that inverse nucleon bremsstrahlung in the cold star absorbs every ALP whose orbit enters it within minutes, long before it decays, so only ALPs born outside the final star on nearly circular orbits survive; they carry $9\times 10^{-9} - 6\times 10^{-5}$ of the heating. We compute the protoneutron-star evolution, the production, the general-relativistic orbits and the absorption ourselves, for twelve protoneutron-star evolutions, three nucleon-bremsstrahlung rates normalized to the same supernova energy loss of light ALPs, and equations of state with and without $\Delta(1232)$ isobars. PSR J2144$-$3933 still excludes a window at $m_a\simeq 7.7-196$\ MeV, with a lower edge in the photon coupling $280-700$ times higher than without absorption. Pion conversion and the $\Delta(1232)$ resonance, which raise the production of surviving ALPs more than their absorption, widen this window to $m_a\simeq$ $7.7-260$\ MeV. The window depends at similar levels on the bremsstrahlung rate and on the radius of the final star. It requires a direct photon coupling that cancels the one induced by ALP-pion mixing, and existing supernova gamma-ray limits may already cover it.
summary:
1. 作者结合十二组原中子星演化与广义相对论轨道追踪，计入核子逆轫致吸收，重估超新星束缚类轴子衰变加热老年中子星的光子耦合约束。
2. 穿星粒子在分钟内被吸收，仅星外近圆轨道上的粒子幸存，使J2144−3933光子耦合排除窗口的下缘较忽略吸收时上移280—700倍。
3. 残余窗口要求直接光子耦合抵消π混合诱导项，尚需重算超新星伽马射线约束，并用包含类轴子冷却反馈的演化检验其稳健性。

title: Carrollian CFTs and the Light Front
abstract: Carrollian symmetries play an important role in building holographic duals to asymptotically flat spacetimes (AFS). This construction hinges on the isomorphism between the (asymptotic) isometries of AFS and the conformal Carroll algebra. Carroll symmetries also naturally arise on the lightfront, as co-dimension one subalgebras in the Poincare algebra written in lightcone coordinates. In this paper, building on the isomorphism between four dimensional (4d) Poincare and 3d conformal Carroll algebras, we make a connection between physics on the lightfront and Carrollian CFTs. Using insights from the lightfront literature, we construct new representations of Carroll CFTs that connect to massive bulk scattering. We compute two-point functions and build a map between 3d Carroll CFTs and 4d lightfront theories living in AFS.
summary:
1. 为探索三维卡罗尔共形场论如何描述有质量散射，作者利用其全局对称代数与四维光前代数的同构，构造平移作用非局域的新诱导表示。
2. 无需初级场条件，仅用运动学沃德恒等式即可得到超局域两点函数，并由可逆积分变换复现有质量标量的光前树级两点振幅。
3. 该框架有望推广至高自旋，但显式检验仅涉及标量两点及运动学禁戒的等质量三点过程，尚不构成引力全息对偶。

title: Large-$N$ limit of chiral quiver theories: free energy, supersymmetric indices and operator counting
abstract: We find the first analytic solution to the large-$N$ saddle point equations for the $S^3$ free energy of a chiral $\mathcal N=2$ Chern-Simons-matter theory with an M-theory dual. Focusing on the chiral quiver dual to AdS$_4\times Q^{1,1,1}/\mathbb Z_{\rm k}$, we show how the long-range forces of the matrix model cancel at large $N$, resolving a long-standing tension with the expected $N^{3/2}$ scaling. The resulting free energy precisely matches the holographic prediction for all assignments of trial R-charges. Our results extend to the superconformal and topologically twisted indices on $S^2\times S^1$, whose large-$N$ and Cardy limit is determined by the same saddle. The solution agrees with the predictions of the operator counting method, giving strong evidence for this conjecture beyond non-chiral quivers. We support the analytic solution with a finite-$N$ numerical analysis for multiple assignments of R-charges, extending recent numerical results obtained for this quiver.
summary:
1. 针对手征陈–西蒙斯物质理论的三球自由能标度难题，作者结合局域化矩阵模型、算符计数与有限N数值检验，解析求解了$Q^{1,1,1}/\mathbb Z_k$对偶模型的大N鞍点。
2. 近极点的$1/N$本征值修正及一般试探R荷下节点共有的$O(N)$虚部抵消长程力，所得$N^{3/2}$自由能在适用参数域内离壳吻合全息预测。
3. 同一鞍点还确定超共形与拓扑扭曲指数的大N及Cardy极限主项，但推广至其他手征模型及判定竞争鞍点主导性仍待研究。

title: Superstring Field Theory with Double Background Independence
abstract: A recently constructed superstring field theory has two decoupled sectors, the physical superstring and a shadow sector with a second copy of the superstring. These are both expanded around the same background conformal field theory and the theory is independent of marginal deformations of this common background. A form of the action is presented that is symmetric between the two sectors. A generalisation of this theory is given in which the two sectors can be expanded around two different backgrounds, and the theory is independent under separate marginal deformations of the two background conformal field theories.
summary:
1. 为考察物理弦与影子弦能否选取不同背景，作者以共享希尔伯特空间的两套超L∞代数构造含二次修正项的经典超弦场作用量。
2. 在两背景满足BRST兼容条件时，两个相互作用扇区保持完全解耦，且绕一般解展开仍得到同形作用量，不再局限于共用背景。
3. 该构造支持两背景独立边际形变下的等价性，但其确立仍需推广既有论证，BV量子化留待后续研究。

title: Majorana Neutrino Physics and Matter-Antimatter Asymmetry in Type IIA String Theory
abstract: We study Majorana neutrino masses and the matter-antimatter asymmetry in Type IIA string theory on a $T^6/(\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2)$ orientifold with intersecting D6-branes. Euclidean D2-instantons with $\text{Sp}(2)$ Chan-Paton symmetry generate both the seesaw mechanism and the Weinberg operator. The flavour vectors are not computed from a compactification but fixed by matching, so our results are an existence proof. Matching the measured mass-squared differences selects the seesaw-dominated case with normal ordering. Swampland criteria constrain the instanton action and the reheating temperature. A benchmark example reproduces the neutrino parameters, gives $\eta_B \approx 8.6 \times 10^{-11}$, within an order of magnitude of observation, and predicts $\langle m_{\beta \beta} \rangle =2.594 \text{meV}$. A parameter scan shows the mass hierarchy is accommodated rather than predicted.
summary:
1. 作者在IIA型相交D6膜模型中，利用Sp(2) D2瞬子诱导的质量矩阵与数据匹配，研究马约拉纳中微子质量和重子不对称的共同起源。
2. 正序跷跷板基准的热轻子生成给出η_B≈8.64×10⁻¹¹，仍低于观测值，扫描仅0.89%的样本进入目标质量窗且需受抑制的味矢量。
3. 味矢量未由几何导出，故层级仅被容纳而非预测，仍需具体紧致化与模稳定计算，若低再热猜想成立还须验证非热轻子生成。

title: On functional classes in higher-spin theory
abstract: The factorization over the ideal in the $d$-dimensional Vasiliev theory requires an accurate description of the higher-spin algebra $\mathcal{A}$ and its twisted adjoint module $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ as certain functional spaces. It is shown that the conditions of $\mathcal{A}$ to be closed under action of the Moyal star product, and of $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ to be a star-product $\mathcal{A}$-module along with some auxiliary conditions lead to properly defined free-level factorization procedure. The conditions on admissible functions have simple algebraic form; in the case of $\mathcal{A}$ the analogous functional space has been considered by Soloviev \cite{Soloviev:2013iba}. The relation of the obtained functional classes to the locality problem in the Vasiliev theory is discussed. In particular it is observed that certain non-local expressions diverge due to properties of $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ while the spin-local expressions are well-defined.
summary:
1. 针对d维Vasiliev玻色高自旋理论无限级数按理想取商的问题，作者以Moyal星积闭合性、模条件和BRST上同调刻画容许函数类。
2. 所得函数类使自由级取商良定，并揭示奇数维扭曲伴随模通常需采用准无迹代表，避免物理场被理想取商消去。
3. 四维平面波检验中某些非局域顶点发散而所考察的自旋局域顶点良定，提示可据函数类筛选相互作用，但非线性推广仍待建立。

title: Initial conditions leave IR imprints in quantum cosmology
abstract: We investigate the gravitational path integral of $\mathbb{R} \times S^3$ geometries in Lorentzian signature along with the metric fluctuations which live on the $S^3$ hypersurfaces. Each metric configuration is characterised by lapse, scale factor and fluctuations, and is weighted by the exponential of the Einstein-Hilbert action. A particular boundary requirement for the scale-factor is achievable via an infinite family of covariant boundary actions, each restricting the boundary behaviour of the fluctuation field which cannot be arbitrarily chosen. The paper explores the effect of this infinite family of covariant boundary actions on the wavefunction of Universe to one-loop. These boundary actions are characterized by parameters $c$ and $\omega$. Dominant contribution of initial momentum in the path-integral restricts $\omega$ to be half-integer, leading to an infinite family of $c$-dependent conjugate momenta. In special case for fixed $\omega$, four such $c$-dependent dominant branches of conjugate momenta emerge: two lead to deSitter, one leads to Hartle-Hawking and one to the tunnelling Universe. For all these $c$-dependent initial conjugate momenta, the lapse-saddles are relevant, however only, one of deSitter saddle and Hartle Hawking saddle have well-behaved perturbations. The one-loop wavefunction at these well-behaved saddles is computed systematically by isolating the UV-divergences, where the covariant boundary parameter $c$ acts as a UV-regulator and also helps in shifting the poles of one-loop determinant, away from the real $q_f$ axis for dS saddles, where $q_f$ is the final size of the Universe. UV-finite wavefunction for no-boundary and dS is obtained by adding suitable counterterms. The infrared behaviour of these wavefunctions show not only IR-divergences but also sensitivity toward the initial boundary choices.
summary:
1. 作者在闭合宇宙模型中，用含协变边界项的洛伦兹引力路径积分计算含张量扰动的一圈宇宙波函数，检验初始边界选择的晚期影响。
2. 边界参数c兼作紫外调节量，加入反项后近无边界与近德西特波函数仍呈不同的红外增长，后者新增正比于√c的增长项。
3. 结论基于边界扰动为零、忽略反作用及小c展开，初态依赖在深红外是否保留仍需非微扰计算或重求和检验。

title: The Effective Kerr-Compton Tree Amplitude from Black Hole Perturbation Theory
abstract: We develop a new method to construct the tree-level Compton amplitude for gravitational-wave scattering off a Kerr black hole in post-Minkowskian effective field theory. Building on previous computations that required physical consistency of the amplitude, the method uses wave scattering functions from black hole perturbation theory to uniquely determine additional contact terms. We illustrate the iterative procedure by deriving explicit expressions up to sixth order in spin, including previously unknown sectors at the fifth and sixth orders in spin. The amplitude features complex transcendental structures and a leading dissipative contact term at sixth order in spin. We verify our result against known results in the literature and reproduce the one-loop tail result from black hole perturbation theory.
summary:
1. 作者利用黑洞微扰理论的波散射函数，在后闵可夫斯基有效场论中迭代构造引力波与克尔黑洞散射的树级康普顿振幅，唯一确定额外接触项。
2. 显式振幅推至自旋六阶，包含此前未知的五、六阶扇区及六阶主导耗散接触项，并复现黑洞微扰理论的一圈尾效应。
3. 该迭代框架有望扩展至更高自旋阶，但当前展示的显式结果限于六阶。

title: $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills Flux Tube in AdS
abstract: We study a supersymmetric Wilson line on the boundary of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory in AdS$_4$, or equivalently on a half-space, as a model for exploring the connection between holographic strings and confining flux tubes. The boundary breaks four-dimensional conformal symmetry and is expected to remove integrability, bringing this system closer to a confining string while preserving enough supersymmetry to constrain its dynamics. Working in the planar limit, we analyze the defect spectrum at weak and strong coupling and compute the superconformal index, thereby relating the perturbative gauge-theory description to the worldsheet excitations of a long holographic string. These complementary perspectives allow us to propose a map between operators in the two regimes, under which the worldsheet axion, in particular, becomes a two-particle state at strong coupling. The resulting picture supports a smooth interpolation from an exponentially growing gauge-theory spectrum to the Cardy-like spectrum of a string worldsheet, providing a non-integrable supersymmetric model for investigating the spectral reorganization expected in confining gauge theories.
summary:
1. 为联系规范通量管与全息弦，作者在平面极限研究AdS₄中N=4超杨–米尔斯理论的边界超对称Wilson线，分析弱强耦合缺陷谱并计算超共形指数。
2. NS5膜数趋于无穷时，两端指数吻合；若同量子数能级不交叉，轴子候选算符对应强耦合双粒子态，标度维数由2变为3。
3. 这为研究禁闭通量管的谱重组提供参照，但谱的平滑插值尚未证明，纯诺伊曼边界的强耦合超引力描述也不受控。

title: A density calculus for quantum field theory
abstract: These notes provide an introduction to Haagerup noncommutative $L^p$ spaces for quantum field theorists. The aim is to explain how the familiar calculus of density matrices, fractional powers, and Schatten norms extends to local observable algebras of type~III, where an intrinsic trace is unavailable. We develop the construction first for a matrix algebra, making the crossed product, its trace, and the dual action explicit, before passing to general von Neumann algebras. Particular attention is paid to the representation of normal states by Haagerup densities and to the distinction between the crossed-product trace and the canonical Haagerup functional used to compute expectation values. As a concrete application, we calculate the sandwiched Rényi divergence for a coherent excitation of a chiral current, verifying monotonicity under restriction and the Rényi quantum null energy condition at every real order $\alpha>1$. The presentation assumes familiarity with quantum mechanics and elementary quantum field theory, while introducing the operator-algebraic concepts needed for the construction and calculation.
summary:
1. 针对量子场论III型局域代数无内禀迹的问题，作者用交叉积与Haagerup非交换L^p空间表述态密度，并以正幂分解计算半直线手征电流的相干态散度。
2. 特定相干激发相对真空的夹心Rényi散度为相对熵的α(α+1)/2倍，在所有有限实数阶α>1下随切口前移递减且凸，验证该例的Rényi量子零能条件。
3. 推广此处的显式计算至非相干态或非几何模流区域，仍需掌握相应模动力学并检验高阶散度的有限性。

title: Quantum curves of 6d SCFTs on a -3 curve
abstract: We study half-BPS defects and quantum Seiberg-Witten curves in 6d $ \mathcal{N}=(1,0) $ SCFTs on a $ -3 $ curve. We compute the partition functions in the presence of codimension-4 and codimension-2 defects on $ \mathbb{R}^4 \times T^2 $ using generalized blowup equations. We then propose quantum Seiberg-Witten curves as elliptic difference equations satisfied by the Nekrasov-Shatashvili limits of the defect partition functions. We apply this construction to the minimal $ \mathfrak{su}(3) $ gauge theory, and to the $ \mathfrak{g}_2 $ and $ \mathfrak{so}(N) $ gauge theories on a Higgsing tree whose endpoint is the minimal $ \mathfrak{su}(3) $ theory. We also investigate defects and the quantum curve of the $ \mathfrak{su}(3) $ gauge theory compactified on a circle with a $ \mathbb{Z}_2 $ twist.
summary:
1. 针对−3曲线上六维超共形场论的低能几何量子化，作者用广义爆破方程递推余维二、四缺陷配分函数，并在NS极限提出量子Seiberg–Witten曲线。
2. su(3)、g₂、so(N)（7≤N≤10）及Z₂扭曲su(3)的曲线共享三移位椭圆差分结构，均检验至三弦阶，纯su(3)经典周期亦复现单弦零亏格自由能。
3. Higgs化的一致性支持这一无需显式弦世界面描述的计算路径，但量子曲线对任意弦数的成立性仍待证明。

title: Competition and coexistence of baryonic condensates in AdS hardwall model
abstract: Cold dense QCD admits several order parameters for baryon-number breaking, among them diquark and dibaryon condensates. We ask whether they exclude one another or coexist, using a five-dimensional AdS hardwall model with full backreaction in which two charged scalars, dual to operators of charges $q_i$ and dimensions $\Delta_i$, couple to a common $U(1)_B$ gauge field. With the diquark-like operator fixed at $q_1=2$, $\Delta_1=3$, both operators condense only within a narrow window of $\Delta_2$, which widens with $q_2$ and closes when the operators coincide. Outside the window, only a single condensate forms. The structure persists in both confined and deconfined phases. In the $\mu_B$-$T$ plane, confined matter with both condensates is preferred at low temperature, below a narrow band of deconfined matter with one condensate.
summary:
1. 作者在计入完全反作用的五维AdS硬墙模型中引入两个带电标量，以压强最大化研究类双夸克与类双重子凝聚能否共存。
2. 固定(q₁,Δ₁)=(2,3)时，μ_B≈1.91 GeV处q₂=6的禁闭共存窗为5.692<Δ₂<6.193，所算低温高密区域优选禁闭共存相。
3. 共存要求双重子算符维数显著降低，但边界条件导致热力学密度与电荷密度不符，且未含标量直接耦合，中子星状态方程应用仍需改进模型。

title: $\mathcal{N}=2$ conformal higher-spin actions in harmonic superspace
abstract: We construct linearized $4D, \mathcal{N}=2$ Weyl-type off-shell actions in harmonic superspace for the superconformal higher-spin gauge multiplets introduced in arXiv:2404.19016 . This work is a followup of our arXiv:2511.16325 , where an analogous construction was carried out for conformal $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity. We check the superconformal invariance of the new actions and their linearized gauge invariance. As the characteristic features of our formulation, the structure of the underlying prepotentials and their gauge and superconformal transformations are entirely determined by the fundamental \textit{principle of Grassmann harmonic analyticity}, while the construction of the invariant actions and of the generalized $\mathcal{N}=2$ super-Weyl tensors relies upon the \textit{principle of Grassmann half-analyticity}. This provides not only a new geometric framework for the linearized $\mathcal{N}=2$ superconformal gauge higher-spin theories, but also suggests possible ways of promoting them to the full nonlinear level. We consider a generalization to an arbitrary $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity background and show that the linearized spin-$\mathbf{s}$ gauge invariance, without radical modifications of the gauge transformation law and/or harmonic zero-curvature equations, is consistent only with $\mathcal{N}=2$ Weyl-flat super-backgrounds.
summary:
1. 针对四维N=2超共形高自旋多重态的离壳动力学，作者在谐超空间利用半解析性构造任意整数自旋的线性化外尔型作用量。
2. 仅用两个协变超场即可得到手征且不依赖谐变量的超外尔张量，并验证作用量的线性规范和刚性超共形不变性。
3. 直接协变化仅在背景超外尔张量为零时保持高自旋规范不变性，一般超引力背景耦合仍需探索规范变换或谐零曲率方程的形变。

title: Bounds on the Diagonal Degree of the Biadjoint Scalar Amplitude Matrix
abstract: Biadjoint scalar theory partial amplitudes, $m_n(\alpha,\beta)$, define an $(n-1)!/2\times (n-1)!/2$ matrix, $M_n$, with rows and columns labeled by orderings. The CHY construction of $M_n$ implies that its rank is $(n-3)!$. Invertible submatrices of maximal rank enter in the KLT construction relating graviton amplitudes to gluon amplitudes. Motivated by finding the KLT formula with the smallest number of terms, one of the authors posed the question of whether there is a critical $n_c$ such that for all $n>n_c$ there exists a diagonal submatrix of $M_n$ of rank $(n-3)!$. In this work we obtain bounds on the size of the largest non-singular diagonal submatrix of $M_n$, which we call its diagonal degree $\Delta_n$, and we answer the question in the negative. We prove that the diagonal degree is exponentially suppressed relative to the CHY rank: $\Delta_n/(n-3)! = \exp(-\Theta (n))$ as $n\to \infty$. More explicitly, we establish the bounds $\exp(-1.5n)\leq\Delta_n/(n-3)!\leq \exp \left[ -0.01n+O(1)\right]$.
summary:
1. 为检验KLT引力子—胶子振幅关系能否选取对角核，作者结合平衡三分割秩估计与KLT分块递归，约束双伴随标量树振幅矩阵最大可逆对角子矩阵的阶数Δₙ。
2. 证明exp(−1.5n)≤Δₙ/(n−3)!≤exp[−0.01n+O(1)]，即对角度相对CHY秩指数受抑，且n≥73时不可能达到该秩。
3. 这排除了大n下仅含(n−3)!个胶子振幅乘积的对角KLT方案，但一般动量核的最优稀疏性尚未确定，指数上下界亦有待收紧。

title: Exact holographic superfluid at the Bogomolny point: transport, large charge, and Rényi entropies
abstract: The Abelian Higgs model in AdS$_5$, in the probe limit, is a standard holographic model of a strongly coupled superfluid, usually solved numerically. When the scalar mass saturates the Breitenlohner-Freedman bound and the quartic coupling takes the Bogomolny value, its condensed phase can be found in closed form on every static, uncharged AdS$_5$ background with maximally symmetric spatial sections. We prove that it is linearly stable, as is any nodeless probe-limit condensate in the standard quantization with a nonnegative quartic coupling and no superflow. On each slicing it answers a different question about the dual conformal field theory. On the planar black brane it is the superfluid at all temperatures below $T_c$: the superfluid fraction follows the Gorter-Casimir two-fluid law exactly, and the speed and the attenuation of sound are found in closed form. In global AdS$_5$ it describes a state of charge $Q$ on $\mathbb{R}\times S^3$, arguably the lowest-energy one, and gives its scaling dimension in closed form at all $Q$, classically in the bulk. Its excitations include towers that the superfluid effective theory does not describe; they come from an infrared fixed point of the probe sector. The hyperbolic slicing gives in closed form a homogeneous hairy phase of the black holes that compute the charged Rényi entropies of a ball. Its condensate does not vanish at the entangling surface. When sourced by operators inserted there, the phase sets in at Rényi index exactly one at zero chemical potential, as found for a neutral scalar.
summary:
1. 为解析描述远离临界点的强耦合超流，作者在标量质量饱和BF界、四次耦合取Bogomolny值的AdS₅阿贝尔希格斯探针模型中构造不同曲率切片的凝聚态闭式解，并以正能量证明其线性稳定。
2. 平面超流分数在整个凝聚区精确满足n_s/n=1−(T/T_c)^4，球面孤子态的经典标度维数则可对任意电荷解析求得。
3. 大电荷下不退耦的红外激发塔表明纯声子描述不足，但量子及引力反作用修正尚待计算，且双曲均匀鞍点的Rényi熵贡献需纠缠面算符源。

title: Breaking of integrability in elliptic deformations of AdS3 strings with mixed flux
abstract: We construct elliptic deformations of the $AdS_3 \times S^3 \times T^4$ superstring supported by mixed NSNS and RR fluxes in type IIB supergravity and investigate their integrability. The NSNS sector includes a Wess-Zumino term, and imposing that the theory preserves 8 supersymmetries also requires the presence of a B-field coupling the deformed $AdS_3$ and $S^3$ factors. We explore integrability from two different perspectives: through the construction of a flat Lax connection and the computation of the tree-level worldsheet S-matrix. For generic elliptic parameters and NSNS flux, we find inelastic $2 \rightarrow 2$ amplitudes, violating the elasticity required by integrability. In the integrable cases as identified by the Lax analysis, these inelastic amplitudes vanish and the tree-level S-matrix satisfies the classical Yang-Baxter equation. In particular, the addition of a Wess-Zumino term, which preserves integrability in the rational and trigonometric models, breaks integrability for elliptic deformations.
summary:
1. 作者构造IIB超引力中的混合通量AdS₃×S³×T⁴椭圆形变背景，以Lax联络及均匀光锥规范下有质量玻色子的树级世界面散射检验可积性。
2. 一般椭圆形变加入WZ项后出现非弹性2→2散射，即便保留8个超对称亦然，而有理及相容三角极限的树级S矩阵满足弹性要求与经典杨–巴克斯特方程。
3. 这表明保持超对称的通量旋转不保证弦的可积性，其破缺机制及纯RR椭圆模型的全费米子可积表述仍待研究。

title: Holographic duals of JT gravity at finite cutoff: the classical case
abstract: We formulate JT gravity with finite-cutoff boundaries and end-of-the-world branes in the first-order BF formulation. We dynamically reduce the BF model into a one-dimensional system living at the boundaries, generalizing earlier constructions. We obtain in particular a geometrical understanding of the phase space degrees of freedom associated to each of these boundaries. We leverage these results to probe bulk locality and the underlying structure of spacetime. Within our framework, we are able to derive a closed-form expression for the holographic Schwarzian description of JT gravity at finite-cutoff in phase space. The resulting degrees of freedom describe the embedding of the finite-cutoff curve in AdS$_2$. A quantization of these systems is presented in a companion paper.
summary:
1. 为刻画有限截断处JT引力的边界自由度，作者在一阶BF表述中实施哈密顿约化，统一处理截断边界和时空终结膜。
2. 双边系统由测地长度及其共轭动量描述，单边则得到四维相空间的有限截断Schwarzian闭式作用量，其坐标刻画边界曲线在AdS₂中的嵌入。
3. 局域长度正性支持SL⁺(2,ℝ)半群结构，可为量子化与边缘态研究提供线索，但本文限于经典分析，欧氏路径积分的约束实现仍待明确。

title: A Simplified Born Rule for Cosmological Correlators
abstract: Cosmological correlators are natural observables of the primordial universe and are related to wavefunction coefficients by the Born rule. For equal-time in-in correlators in flat spacetime, we prove that all double-boundary poles cancel for arbitrary graphs, including in theories with local derivative interactions. These cancellations occur before integration over spatial loop momenta and yield a $\textit{simplified Born rule}$ in terms of what we call embedded wavefunction coefficients. The resulting expansion reveals which physical poles can occur together while keeping the interaction dependence explicit. For conformally coupled $\operatorname{Tr}(\phi^3)$ theory in flat spacetime, the simplified Born rule takes the form of a uniformly weighted forest-cut expansion. From its pole combinatorics, we construct what we call the $\textit{Born polytope}$, whose canonical function reproduces the normalized correlator for arbitrary graphs after matching its facet supports to the physical energies. The same geometry also yields a stringy formula for correlators.
summary:
1. 为厘清宇宙学关联函数的极点结构，作者在平直时空等时in-in框架中引入嵌入式波函数系数，建立简化玻恩规则。
2. 他们证明含局域导数相互作用的任意图中，双边界极点在空间圈动量积分前全部抵消，并为共形耦合Tr(φ³)模型得到等权森林切割展开。
3. 玻恩多胞体的典范函数在匹配物理能量后重现该模型任意图的归一化关联函数，相应几何还给出弦式公式，但向膨胀时空推广仍需验证。

title: Gravity between two masses beyond Newton's law
abstract: Newton's law of universal gravitation describes the attraction between two masses through an inverse-distance potential. In Einstein's theory gravity gravitates: each mass reshapes the spacetime geometry through which the other acts. More than a century later, extracting the two-body interaction from this coupled geometry remains a fundamental analytical challenge. Even without motion or radiation, the static sector of the interaction harbours an infinite hierarchy of field couplings: the purest laboratory for gravitational non-linearity. Here we determine the static interaction from ninth to twelfth order in Newton's constant for arbitrary mass ratios, and derive a closed expression for the first backreaction beyond the Schwarzschild test-body limit to all orders in the gravitational coupling. We achieve both advances by formulating the problem around the stationary interaction energy. An exact one-body background resums one source's self-interaction, stationarity reduces the fields required from the other, and integrated response identities reveal cancellations across the coupled modes. Complementary expansions then resolve the complete mass dependence at finite order. Together, these results bridge the gap between an infinitesimal probe and comparable masses, exposing hidden analytical simplicity within Einstein's theory and providing essential building blocks for modelling orbital dynamics and gravitational-wave generation.
summary:
1. 作者在谐和规范下利用能量驻值性，结合精确史瓦西背景与维数正规化，计算两个无自旋点粒子的非线性静态引力势。
2. 研究新增任意质量比的G⁹—G¹²势项，并导出首阶质量比修正的G全阶闭式，但三个高阶关联函数的有理值仅获约22位有效数字的数值支持。
3. 这些规范依赖的静态结果可为高阶轨道模型提供输入，但引力波预测仍需补充速度依赖、尾效应及辐射贡献。

title: Generalised $Ω$-backgrounds in twisted $N=4$ super Yang-Mills
abstract: We introduce rigid supergravity backgrounds for 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills which deform its topological twists and generalise the $\Omega$-deformation of $\mathcal{N}=2$ gauge theories. We derive the twisted supersymmetry variations of the $\mathcal{N}=4$ Weyl multiplet, and the $\mathcal{N}=4$ matter multiplet coupled to a rigid bosonic background, for each of the three inequivalent topological twists. Other, more exotic backgrounds are also discussed.
summary:
1. 为推广四维N=4超杨–米尔斯理论的Ω形变，作者利用离壳共形超引力，在具相容等距的欧氏流形上构造三种拓扑扭曲的刚性背景。
2. DW、VW与GL分别保留1、2、2个等变超荷，GL形变参数较先前平直空间构造加倍，VW通过时空依赖复耦合放宽两对易Killing向量内积恒定的约束。
3. 这些背景有望拓展受保护观测量的局域化计算，但dilatino方程仅在选定几何上数值检验，一般解析验证仍待完成。

title: Localization in Seven-Dimensional Supergravity
abstract: Seven-dimensional supergravity provides holographic access to strongly coupled six-dimensional superconformal theories through its highest-dimensional supersymmetric AdS vacua. Its unique spinor-bilinear geometry and massive higher-form dynamics make systematic analysis and solution-finding distinctively challenging. Relative equivariant localization can obtain supersymmetric observables in odd dimensions from fixed-point data on an auxiliary even-dimensional filling, without an explicit solution. We extend this approach to seven dimensions in maximal Cartan-gauged supergravity with all gauge fields active. We formulate the Euclidean action and Killing-spinor equations in terms of field strengths, and construct a bilinear system adapted to the change in spinor reality conditions from symplectic-Majorana to Majorana. On the non-null gauged active spinor branch, independent, oppositely R-charged spinors are paired by Majorana conjugation on the same complex background. One algebraic gauging correction and two algebraic bilinear projections suffice to extend the equal-charge sector to independent Cartan charges, and the underlying efficient reorganization also applies in the Lorentzian theory. Massive 3-form self-duality fixes the quartic anomaly class and determines the higher-form fixed-point datum from Abelian moment maps. Localization at the single fixed point of the filling recovers the general supersymmetric AdS$_7$ black-hole action, without extending the solution. We prove gauge-covariant Killing-spinor invariance under the combined supersymmetric Killing flow and R-symmetry action, deriving the linear chemical-potential constraint. Extremizing the constrained entropy functional and requiring real positive stationary entropy yields the nonlinear charge relation within the Euclidean analysis, equivalent to Lorentzian horizon extremality for the known spherical black-hole family.
summary:
1. 针对无须显式解的超对称黑洞热力学计算，作者在七维极大超引力的嘉当规范截断中保留双阿贝尔场与有质量三形式，以欧氏旋量双线性构造相对等变局域化。
2. 三形式自对偶固定四次反常类，在光滑拼接假设下，辅助八维球体的单个不动点重现两电荷、三个角动量的球形视界AdS₇黑洞作用量。
3. 驻点熵的实正性导出非线性电荷约束，在已知球形分支等价于洛伦兹视界极端性，而其他拓扑及高阶导数修正仍待研究。

title: Thermodynamics of Swirling Black Holes and Kerr-Taub-NUT
abstract: We establish the first law of black hole thermodynamics for the recently discovered Kerr swirling (KS) and accelerated Kerr swirling (AKS) black hole solutions. We also revisit the first law for the Kerr-Taub-NUT (KTN) spacetime. Guided by Noether's original insight that global symmetries give rise to conservation laws, we employ and adapt the surface charge method for computing the associated charges (mass and angular momentum) in the presence of spacetime string-like defects (conical singularities) along the axes of both KS and KTN black holes. We obtain finite integrated charges in a quasi-local manner, without relying on the non-flat asymptotic regions characteristic of these spacetimes. We then establish a first law without introducing independent stringy terms unrelated to symmetries. For both KS and KTN, the quantities that play the role of the black hole entropy differ from the simple geometrical rule of one-fourth of the horizon area. This mismatch arises because we keep first-law charges associated with conservation laws. It indicates that standard formulas may not be naively used for black holes with string-like defects; they have a different topology and suggest the need for a new geometrical framework. In stark contrast, for the AKS spacetime, which can be regularized outside the singularity and lacks string-like defects, we find that the charges are consistent with a first law having the usual one-fourth of the area entropy. We first determine the mass using the Christodoulou-Ruffini formula and then check its agreement with the result obtained from the surface charge method.
summary:
1. 作者将轴向缺陷周围的锥面边界贡献纳入准局域表面荷法，研究非渐近平坦的旋涡克尔、其加速解及克尔–陶布–NUT黑洞的守恒荷与第一定律。
2. 不增设独立弦变量时，含缺陷解的推定熵偏离视界面积四分之一；无缺陷加速解按面积律构造的候选质量与表面荷计算吻合至加速度展开四阶。
3. 缺陷解的温度与熵仍需独立推导，而加速解所用Christodoulou–Ruffini质量关系的普适性尚待证明。

title: On Geometric Observables in Gravity
abstract: Measures of geometry like distance and time are staples of classical gravity. While geometric quantities arise broadly in quantum gravity, their graviton corrections are less explored. In this paper, we study geometric observables in perturbative quantum gravity. We form distance and time observables that model measurements, including in the presence of spacetime fluctuations. Gravitational dressing ensures these constructions are coordinate invariant. Then we show how these finite-distance observables become memory and Shapiro time delay operators upon taking asymptotic limits. We compute leading graviton effects in correlators of geometric observables throughout. Altogether, our results identify a class of geometric observables that link experiments and operations on the celestial sphere.
summary:
1. 为刻画时空量子涨落中的距离与计时，作者在平直背景引力有效场论中以测地世界线引力缀饰构造坐标不变算符，并计算其关联函数的领先引力子贡献。
2. 不同渐近极限将距离变化和单程计时分别联系到引力记忆与夏皮罗时延，时延二点函数随传播距离对数发散，而时延差关联红外有限。
3. 该框架有望用于量子因果性与高阶修正研究，但与具体干涉仪读出的完整对应仍待建立，所算真空效应远低于可测水平。

title: Exact Solution of the $(2+1)$-Dimensional Dunkl-Klein-Gordon Oscillator with a Uniform Magnetic Field in Non-Commutative Phase Space
abstract: We solve the Klein-Gordon oscillator in a non-commutative phase space, generalized using Dunkl derivatives, both with and without interaction with a uniform magnetic field. For each of these cases, we begin by introducing the Dunkl derivative into the standard commutative phase space to evaluate the reflection parity symmetries. Then, using the Seiberg-Witten map, we extend the generalized system to a non-commutative phase space. In both cases, we determine the eigenfunctions and the energy spectrum exactly (which correspond to generalized Landau levels when a magnetic field is present). Furthermore, we compute the non-relativistic limit of the system and graphically analyze the behavior of the energy spectra. Our results demonstrate that the combination of the Dunkl deformation parameters, the non-commutative phase space geometry, and the magnetic field produces a parity-dependent modification of the energy levels. Finally, we verify that when the external magnetic field or the non-commutative parameters vanish, our exact solutions correctly reduce to the commutative Dunkl models established in previous works.
summary:
1. 为考察非对易几何与反射形变如何改变标量能谱，作者先引入Dunkl导数，再用Seiberg–Witten映射，解析研究有无匀强磁场的二维克莱因–戈尔登振子。
2. 作者给出拉盖尔型径向解与宇称相关的广义朗道谱，并推导含反射算符修正的相空间对易关系，对易极限恢复已有模型。
3. 其非相对论极限可为低能模型提供形式参照，但单轴反射与角动量不对易，能谱推导中共同本征态假设的相容性仍需核查。

title: Algebraic Quantum Field Theory
abstract: Algebraic quantum field theory describes a quantum system through its observables, their localisation in spacetime, and the states that assign them expectation values. The separation of the specification of observables from the choice of a state makes it possible to compare vacuum, thermal and charged representations without assuming that they share a preferred Hilbert space. We develop the framework from familiar quantum mechanics, construct the free scalar field, and explain how causality and positive energy constrain local measurements. The Reeh--Schlieder theorem, the structure of local von Neumann algebras and the split property reveal key differences between quantum theory in the continuum (i.e. QFT) and ordinary quantum mechanics with finitely many degrees of freedom. Superselection theory relates observable charges to statistics and internal symmetries. Finally, local covariance and perturbative and homological methods extend the discussion to curved spacetime, interactions and gauge theories. We also discuss measurement theory and quantum information aspects of AQFT.
summary:
1. 作者以自由标量场为例，综述如何通过局域代数网将可观测量与态分离，在不预设优选表示时刻画量子关联与相对论因果性。
2. 适当假设下，局域代数为Ⅲ₁型因子而无内禀约化密度矩阵，分裂性质则允许有间隔区域的正规乘积态，区分了真空关联与独立制备。
3. 局域协变与因果重整化支持全局双曲时空上的相互作用构造，但形式微扰不保证收敛，非微扰代数也不自动给出物理可接受态。

title: From gauge-covariant Noether invariants to electromagnetic velocity-dependent mechanics
abstract: For a charged particle, a spacetime symmetry need preserve the electromagnetic potential only up to a gauge transformation. Starting from the standard Noether--Bessel-Hagen construction, we make explicit the reduction from the relativistic gauge-invariant worldline charge to the generalized constants of nonrelativistic velocity-dependent mechanics, retaining the quasi-invariance boundary term throughout. With the convention $S_p=-mc\int ds+q\int A$, the canonical worldline one-form is $P=-m u^\flat+qA$, and a Killing vector satisfying $\mathcal L_XA=d\chi_X$ generates $C_X=P(X)-q\chi_X$. Its low-velocity limit is the Noether--Bessel-Hagen charge of the coordinate-time Lagrangian, from which generalized linear momentum, angular momentum and energy follow generator by generator. A uniform magnetic field gives an elementary gauge-dependent representative but gauge-invariant translational charge. The Darwin interaction then supplies the conservative $O(c^{-2})$ many-particle realization after field elimination, while a closed particle--field system is governed by the total stress-energy Killing charge. The result is an explicit reduction map linking three established descriptions without identifying their distinct conserved quantities.
summary:
1. 为厘清电磁规范自由下的粒子守恒量，作者保留诺特准不变边界项，建立相对论世界线守恒荷到非相对论速度依赖力学的约化映射。
2. 该映射保持守恒荷的规范不变性，重现匀强磁场赝动量，并衔接消场后O(c⁻²)达尔文多体理论的动量、角动量和能量。
3. 该框架区分外场单粒子与封闭粒子—场系统的守恒量，但达尔文近似忽略辐射，辐射显著时仍须计入场的能动量。

title: Homogenization theory of topological Anderson insulators: genuine gaps and pseudo-gaps
abstract: A topological Anderson insulator is an insulator whose non-trivial topological phase is induced by disorder. We develop a homogenization theory of this phenomenon for constant-coefficient elliptic systems perturbed by fluctuations oscillating at scale $\varepsilon$. Periodic fluctuations of every order below that of the operator, with appropriate amplitudes, do not average out: they produce an order-one correction $M$ given by a second-order (Born) formula, and the operator converges in the norm-resolvent sense to its homogenized limit. In particular, electric potentials and magnetic fields of zero mean, usually regarded as topologically trivial perturbations, generate corrections $M$ that change the topological phase. Fluctuations confined to a half-plane create an interface that carries the bulk-difference invariant of the homogenized operator for all $\varepsilon$ sufficiently small, a property that is stable under local defects. For random fluctuations, rare regions typically fill the homogenized gap, which becomes a pseudo-gap, and the standard interface index need no longer be defined. We define an index along cuts deformed so as to avoid the rare regions, and prove that it equals almost surely the bulk-difference invariant of the operator homogenized in the Born approximation, for first-order alloys with vanishing low moments and for a class of second-order systems with scalar disorder at criticality that includes the BHZ model.
summary:
1. 针对无序诱导拓扑相，作者为受小尺度涨落扰动的常系数椭圆系统建立均匀化理论，并证明范数预解收敛。
2. 适当缩放的周期涨落产生O(1)的二阶Born修正，零均值电势或磁场可改变拓扑相，半平面界面不变量在尺度充分小时对局域缺陷稳定。
3. 随机稀有区可使均匀化能隙变为赝隙并令常规界面指标失去定义，但在含BHZ模型的特定体系中，绕避稀有区的切割指标几乎必然等于Born近似均匀化算符的体不变量差，提供赝隙中的拓扑刻画。

title: Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics of Semilinear Stochastic Partial Differential Equations
abstract: We develop a rigorous mathematical framework for the nonequilibrium thermodynamics of semilinear stochastic partial differential equations. The invariant Gaussian measure of the associated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, which need not be time-reversible, serves as the reference measure. We define thermodynamic quantities in terms of probability densities and derive the entropy balance equation. We obtain explicit expressions for the entropy production rate and prove that its vanishing in the stationary state is equivalent to time reversibility. Sample-path entropy production is identified with the logarithm of the Radon-Nikodym derivative of the forward path measure with respect to the time-reversed path measure and is shown to satisfy fluctuation theorems. For nonstationary systems, sample-path entropy production decomposes into housekeeping heat and free-energy dissipation, each satisfying an integral fluctuation theorem. Both have nonnegative expectations, and the mean free-energy dissipation equals the decrease in relative entropy with respect to the stationary distribution. The theory is applied to semilinear stochastic heat equations with spatially correlated noise, a random polymer model, a nonlinear model with a divergence-free drift, and two coupled stochastic heat equations in contact with heat baths at different temperatures.
summary:
1. 为量化无限维场的不可逆耗散，作者以线性过程的高斯不变测度为参照，通过路径测度变换建立一类半线性随机偏微分方程的热力学框架。
2. 在时间反演表示与正则性等假设下，证明稳态零熵产生率等价于可逆性，并将瞬态熵产生分为各满足积分涨落定理的维持热与自由能耗散，后者均值等于相对稳态分布的相对熵降幅。
3. 双温耦合热场表明高斯稳态也可具有正熵产生率，但纳入空间输运与超线性漂移仍需放宽有界性假设。

title: Finite-volume and thermodynamic-limit lower bounds for the coherently driven Bose--Hubbard model via the Lieb--Yamazaki method
abstract: We derive rigorous lower bounds on the ground-state energy of the coherently driven Bose--Hubbard model using a Lieb--Yamazaki positive-operator decomposition. The resulting quadratic bounding Hamiltonian is diagonalized by displacement and Bogoliubov transformations, yielding explicit stability conditions and finite-volume bounds in arbitrary dimension. We establish the thermodynamic-limit energy density and characterize the excitation spectrum of the bounding Hamiltonian. We also derive its Gaussian-state observables, including filling, number fluctuations, and second-order correlations, and identify regimes of antibunching and sub-Poissonian statistics. Numerical calculations assess the tightness of the bounds across representative parameter regimes.
summary:
1. 为严格约束相干驱动玻色–哈伯德模型的基态能量，作者在任意维周期超立方晶格上以Lieb–Yamazaki正算符分解、位移和Bogoliubov变换求解二次下界哈密顿量。
2. 在辅助模型稳定域内得到有限体积严格下界并证明其密度的热力学极限存在，采样范围内无量纲驱动f≥2时独立优化的上下界相对宽度低于10%。
3. 键簇下界在所比较参数点更紧，而辅助模型的无隙边界与高斯态反聚束是否对应完整模型，仍需张量网络等独立检验。

title: A Primer on Instanton Physics - A Short Course
abstract: These six lectures, delivered at the University of New Brunswick 6-21 October 2026, are an introduction to instantons in quantum mechanics and quantum field theory for senior undergraduate and beginning graduate students. The first four lectures deal solely with particle mechanics, building the necessary background for the last two that cover applications in semi-classical field theory.
summary:
1. 围绕隧穿引起的能级劈裂与真空衰变，讲义用欧氏路径积分及Gel’fand–Yaglom初值法计算涨落行列式，重述从量子力学到场论的半经典瞬子方法。
2. 分离平移零模并作稀薄气体求和，重现双阱劈裂ΔE=2ℏω√(6S₁/πℏ)e^(−S₁/ℏ)，同时以反弹解的负模解释亚稳态能量的虚部。
3. 该教学路线衔接薄壁气泡成核与杨–米尔斯真空拓扑，但稀薄气体结果要求单瞬子作用量S₁≫ℏ，瞬子重叠时需计入相互作用。

title: From Entanglement Bootstrap to DHR Theory
abstract: We establish a direct connection between the entanglement bootstrap and the Doplicher--Haag--Roberts theory of superselection sectors for two-dimensional quantum spin systems. Under the entanglement-bootstrap assumptions, we prove Haag duality and establish a one-to-one correspondence between simple entanglement-bootstrap anyon types and irreducible superselection sectors. For each fusion channel, we further construct an affine bijection from density matrices on the entanglement-bootstrap fusion space to normalized positive intertwiners in the corresponding operator-algebraic fusion channel. These results connect the entropic and operator-algebraic descriptions of anyons directly, without passing through exactly solvable lattice models.
summary:
1. 针对二维量子自旋中纠缠电荷如何对应超选择扇区，作者在纯态的精确局域熵公理下，以信息凸集与Petz恢复构造无限体积带电表示。
2. 证明适当格点锥上的Haag对偶性及简单电荷与不可约DHR扇区一一对应，并建立融合空间密度矩阵与相应代数通道内归一化正算符的仿射双射，确定两侧融合重数一致。
3. 该联系不经可解模型中介，使单个参考态提取的融合数据获得代数解释，但近似熵条件下的对应与完整编织等价仍待证明。

title: The geometry of Floquet states
abstract: This paper studies the moduli space of "good" periodic Hamiltonians, i.e., periodic Hamiltonians with nondegenerate Floquet spectrum. The corresponding Floquet states determine a geometric model for the moduli space of such Hamiltonians. The model is expressed in terms of configuration spaces, flag manifolds, and principal bundles. A corollary of the main result is the complete determination of the rational cohomology ring of the space of good periodic Hamiltonians. The paper also considers the adiabatic driving of a 1-parameter family of good periodic Hamiltonians. We formulate two conjectures describing the resulting asymptotic quantum evolution. These are Floquet analogues of the adiabatic theorem in quantum mechanics.
summary:
1. 针对Floquet谱非简并的n维周期量子系统，作者利用准周期态在射影空间中的闭路及相位一形式，结合主丛方法刻画哈密顿量空间的全局几何。
2. 证明该空间微分同胚于圆周n点构型空间的普适覆盖、SU(n)基点环路空间、实数轴基点环路空间及完全旗流形的乘积，并完整确定其有理上同调环。
3. 所建Floquet联络为几何输运提供框架，但N周期慢驱动下的态跟随及含相位演化的O(1/N)误差界仍属待证猜想。

title: A First-Order Phase Transition in Spin-Imbalanced BCS Theory of Superconductivity
abstract: We study a translation-invariant BCS functional of superconductivity for a system of spin-$1/2$ fermions with spin-dependent chemical potentials, $\mu_+\neq\mu_-$. Numerical work of Caldas and Mota and analytical work of Freiji, Hainzl, and Seiringer has suggested an unusual first-order phase transition in spin-imbalanced BCS models, in which the normal state becomes globally unstable while remaining locally stable. Here, we prove that a first-order phase transition occurs in such spin-imbalanced BCS functionals. For each sufficiently small fixed spin imbalance and sufficiently low temperature, there is a coexistence coupling $\lambda_{\mathrm{fo}}$ strictly below the linear-stability threshold $\lambda_{\mathrm{lin}}$ of the normal state at which the Cooper pair density exhibits a nonzero jump and the minimized energy has a kink. The methodological insight is a coercivity estimate obtained by decomposing the BCS energy minimization into two parts, where the ``inner'' problem minimizes over the one-particle density matrices at fixed pairing and can be exactly solved by a Legendre--Fenchel transform.
summary:
1. 为判定正常态仍局部稳定时能否发生超导转变，作者用勒让德–芬歇尔对偶精确约化平移不变的自旋失衡BCS泛函，并建立非线性强制性估计。
2. 在主导配对通道非简并、固定小失衡和足够低温下，利用临界模的负四阶项证明共存耦合严格低于线性失稳阈值，并确立配对密度跃变、最低自由能折点及正常态亚稳区。
3. 这表明线性判据不足以确定共存相界，推广至简并配对通道及确立温度相界的正则曲线结构仍待研究。

title: Minimally-coupled Quasilinear Symmetric Hyperbolic Systems, Naturally
abstract: We consider symmetric hyperbolicity and well-posedness in the context of natural equations, which are closed subobjects of jet bundles over natural bundles. We show how non-natural equations can be "naturalized", and we discuss how a precise version of "minimal coupling" offers a (provably unique, up to isomorphism) method for constructing natural equations from certain equations defined on a single manifold. We discuss how to define symmetrizers, hyperbolizations, and constraints for minimally coupled natural equations, and we show how these can be used to recover standard existence and uniqueness results, relative to any choice of background structure (a metric, for minimally coupled systems). Additionally, we show that minimal coupling and naturality together imply that the causal cones associated with a (first order, quasilinear, minimally coupled) naturally symmetric hyperbolic natural equation must always coincide with the metric lightcones, and that a certain rank-2 tensor, associates with a natural hyperbolization, must always be divergence free relative to the associated Levi-Civita derivative operator.
summary:
1. 为厘清广义协变性与初值适定性的关系，作者用自然丛和喷射丛将背景度规并入场丛，建立一阶拟线性最小耦合系统的自然双曲化与约束框架。
2. 证明在给定场丛上最小耦合若存在则在同构意义下唯一，且当自然最大双曲化仅依赖度规时，系统因果锥必与度规光锥重合。
3. 该框架为固定度规下的初值分析提供几何条件，但一般局部存在性论证仍有缺口，相关能量型张量的守恒也需附加条件。

title: Higher genus polylogarithms associated with the D'Hoker-Hidding-Schlotterer connection
abstract: We study higher genus polylogarithms associated with the D'Hoker-Hidding-Schlotterer (DHS) connection defined on families of Riemann surfaces of any genus with marked points. Under separating degenerations of Riemann surfaces, we show that the DHS connection can be constructed by gluing the Brown-Levin (BL) connections on elliptic curves and the Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov (KZ) connections on pointed Riemann spheres. Therefore, the associated higher genus polylogarithms can be described explicitly as power series in deformation parameters and their logarithms for the families of Riemann surfaces whose coefficients are expressed by multiple zeta values and elliptic multiple zeta values.
summary:
1. 为发展面向振幅计算的高亏格多对数工具，作者借助Enriquez联络分析分离退化，将椭圆曲线BL联络与标记球面KZ联络粘合为DHS联络。
2. 通过结合子乘积和融合变换下的解析延拓，得到最大退化曲面附近关于形变参数及其对数的显式级数，系数由多重ζ值和椭圆多重ζ值表达。
3. 这些局部公式有望用于多圈费曼积分与弦振幅计算，但本文尚未展示具体物理算例。

title: Generalized Frobenius Structures on Hurwitz Spaces, Their Open Extensions and Associated Principal Hierarchies
abstract: We construct generalized Frobenius structures on Hurwitz spaces of arbitrary genus using extended primary differentials. Through contour integrals involving the Cauchy kernel, we derive explicit dispersionless Lax representations for the principal hierarchies of these structures and their almost-dual counterparts. We also construct solutions to the open WDVV equations for both the original and almost-dual structures, and derive explicit principal hierarchies for the resulting rank-one extensions. Finally, we show that these constructions admit Shramchenko deformations.
summary:
1. 为研究非平坦单位元下几何与可积流的对应，作者利用扩展初级微分及柯西核围道积分，在任意亏格Hurwitz空间的非退化开集构造广义Frobenius结构。
2. 通过直接验证校准递推，作者给出原结构及几乎对偶结构主层级的显式无色散Lax表示，构造开放WDVV解与秩一扩展层级，并推广至Shramchenko形变。
3. 开放扩展依赖局部可逆的阿贝尔积分坐标，该框架有望用于探索拓扑递归及高亏格Whitham几何，但本文尚未构造色散形变。

title: Arithmetic localization for quasiperiodic long-range operators with monotone potentials
abstract: We study one-dimensional quasiperiodic operators with $\alpha$-Hölder monotone potentials and long-range hopping satisfying $|T(x,y)|\leq \varepsilon e^{-\rho |x-y|}$. Under an explicit smallness condition on $\varepsilon$, we establish uniform Anderson localization for such operators in the regime $\rho>\alpha\beta $, where $\beta$ is the exponential strength of frequency resonances. Our proof extends the arithmetic localization strategy for monotone quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators by Jitomirskaya and Kachkovskiy to the long-range setting, without relying on the Lyapunov exponent.
summary:
1. 作者以跃迁截断和格林函数大偏差，研究一维准周期α-Hölder单调势长程算符中频率共振与局域化的竞争。
2. 在显式弱跃迁条件及ρ>αβ下，不借助李雅普诺夫指数证明所有允许相位的一致安德森局域化，本征态衰减率至少为(ρ−αβ)/7，其中ρ、β分别为跃迁指数衰减率和频率共振强度。
3. 该判据仅为充分条件，其最优性及这类长程模型是否存在精确算术转变仍待研究。

title: A Combinatorial Formula and a Hilbert Scheme Realization of a Rank-One Virasoro Irregular Conformal Block
abstract: For general central charge, we give a combinatorial formula and a geometric realization of the formal expansion of the rank-one Virasoro irregular conformal block of type $(0,0,1)$ at its irregular singular point. We realize the normalized block as a coefficientwise matrix element on the localized equivariant Hilbert--Fock space associated with Hilbert schemes of points on $\mathbb C^2$. At $c=1$, we prove the author's conjecture and express the parameter-independent coefficients in terms of skew-tableau numbers and Littlewood--Richardson coefficients, establishing their nonnegativity and integrality. The proof combines sectorial asymptotics of screening integrals with Laguerre--Jack evaluations. We express the screening kernel using the flow of a degree-raising differential operator and compute the Jack coefficients of its exponential from the one-box Pieri rule and the shifted Jack coefficient formula of Okounkov and Olshanski.
summary:
1. 针对(0,0,1)型Virasoro共形块在秩一非正则奇点的展开，作者结合屏蔽积分的扇区渐近、升次数算子流及Laguerre–Jack求值推导组合公式。
2. 一般中心荷下，各阶系数化为有限分拆和，归一化块实现为ℂ²点希尔伯特概形的局部化等变Fock空间矩阵元，且c=1时参数无关组合系数被证明为非负整数。
3. 该构造可为量子Painlevé V相关级数提供计算输入，但几何表达仅是逐阶形式恒等式，并不保证一般参数下展开的收敛性。

title: An Egorov-type Theorem for Analytic Wick Observables in Quantum Field Theory
abstract: We provide an exact Egorov-type formula, given by a convergent expansion in the semi-classical parameter $\varepsilon > 0$, for the propagation of a certain class of analytic Wick observables with super-exponentially decaying coefficients, under the action of a time-dependent quadratic Hamiltonian. This work generalizes a result established by S. Breteaux for polynomial symbols, and includes the spatially cutoff $P(\varphi)_2$ model, as well as a variant of the Höegh-Krohn model.
summary:
1. 针对解析Wick可观测量的量子—经典对应，作者在玻色福克空间结合多项式截断与超收缩估计，研究含时二次哈密顿量下的传播。
2. 对一类系数超指数衰减的符号，证明有限时间窗内、充分小半经典参数下的传播具有精确收敛展开，首项为经典流输运，且符号类中的复共轭需随流变换。
3. 该公式可用于截断场论的相互作用绘景，但所举模型的自由传播修正为零，完整相互作用动力学仍需额外论证。

title: Three-dimensional stress-gradient non-locality problem: Displacement field for an arbitrary and a conservative force
abstract: In order to obtain the displacement field, both generally in the case of an arbitrary body force and specifically in the case of a conservative body force, the mechanical problem of statics of three-dimensional stress-gradient non-local medium is analytically solved on unbounded domain by considering a system of equations consisting of an equilibrium equation, infinitesimal strain, and both scalar- and tensor-type stress-gradient Eringen three-dimensional models. Since the system of equations is linear, for each model the solution is obtained in the form of a superposition of the local-type displacement field, common to each model, and the non-local-type displacement field, specific to the non-locality operator of the model. Among the three scalar-type and five tensor-type considered models, six distinct analytical displacement field expressions are obtained for an arbitrary body force: one expression specific to a scalar-type model, three specific to individual tensor-type models, while each of the remaining two expressions are common to one scalar- and one tensor-type model. The displacement vector fields are graphically represented in the case of gravitational body force, yielding five different models, since two tensor-type models become the same when the force is conservative.
summary:
1. 为刻画体力诱导的非局域静态位移，作者用傅里叶变换求解无界三维线弹性体的三种标量型与五种张量型应力梯度模型，分离共同局域项和模型特定修正。
2. 八种模型在任意体力下对应六类位移解、保守力下为五类，引力下T₂、T₄在纵横波速平方比β>1时出现半径L√(β−1)的零位移环，L为非局域长度。
3. 解析格林张量可为本构比较和积分数值计算提供基准，但结果限于无界小应变静力框架，有限边界效应尚待研究。

title: Optimization Inverse Spectral Problems for Sturm--Liouville Operators with Potentials in $L^p(0,1)$
abstract: We study an optimization inverse spectral problem (OISP) for a one-dimensional Sturm--Liouville operator on a finite interval. The problem is to find a potential $V \in L^p(0,1)$ that realizes a prescribed finite set $\lambda_1^* < \lambda_2^* < \dots < \lambda_m^*$ and has the smallest $L^p(0,1)$-distance from an a priori given potential $V_0 \in L^p(0,1)$. We formulate and prove results on the regularity of the isospectral manifold, the existence of an OISP solution, and an explicit analytic representation of the optimal potential by means of a power map applied to a linear combination of squared eigenfunctions. Using a unified differential-algebraic approach to squared eigenfunctions, we show that whenever these squares are linearly dependent, the corresponding potential can be expressed in terms of them and is an analytic function. For $p=2$, we prove that nondegenerate stationary points are isolated and that the number of global minima is finite provided that each of them is nondegenerate. For every $1<p<\infty$, we establish uniqueness for the first eigenvalue when $\lambda_1^*\ge\lambda_1(V_0)$ and generic global uniqueness in the sense of Baire category in $L^p(0,1)$. A separate section provides examples with at least two global minima for $m=1,2$ in the presence of a sufficiently high finite symmetric barrier. We describe an iteration with frozen eigenfunctions and a local Newton--KKT method with continuation in the spectral data, and state explicitly the limits of their guarantees. The final part discusses applications of OISP theory to nonlinear boundary value problems and to applied problems of diagnostics and optimal spectral design of acoustic and electromagnetic resonators.
summary:
